schematics.author: JMAO01, LotoEU99
schematics.description: A large automatic cactus farm built on a 4 by 4 chunk footprint, roughly 90 blocks wide, 90 deep and 176 high, with a water-fed grid of sand and cactus channels and a hidden central area. Its walls and frame are white stained glass with oak and spruce fence gates, and the tall outer structure is mostly cactus and sand with about 155,000 blocks total. The source gives a rate of about 50,000 cactus per hour, and it contains no block entities such as chests or hoppers.

schematics.author: b333nja
schematics.description: A medieval-style house built mostly from spruce slabs, stairs and stripped spruce logs, with stone, andesite, tuff and deepslate brick walls and dark oak planks. It is about 32 wide, 34 high and 26 deep, with a stepped roofline. The interior is furnished with chests, barrels, beds, a furnace, a blast furnace, a brewing stand, a bell, banners, a jukebox and other utility blocks.

schematics.author: FlyingPenguin33

title.es: Transbordador Espacial en Plataforma de Lanzamiento
title.pt: Ônibus Espacial na Plataforma de Lançamento

schematics.description: A 1:1 scale replica of a space shuttle standing on its launch pad, built mostly from iron blocks with white, red, and orange wool for the orbiter and external tank details. It is about 76 wide, 105 high, and 91 deep, made of roughly 37,600 blocks, with a small chest as the only block entity and a flat stone and cobblestone pad beneath it.

schematics.author: TheOfficialNano
schematics.description: A large-scale replica of a space-needle style observation tower, standing on four legs with a wide quartz saucer-shaped top section and a slender central spire. Built mostly from gray wool, stone slabs, quartz blocks and glass, with glowstone accents and a few oak details. Roughly 53 by 53 blocks across and 185 blocks tall, with about 16,000 blocks in total; the observation deck is a rounded top ring with windows, and the inside is not documented.

schematics.author: Tiresh
schematics.description: A tall modern glass skyscraper modeled on the 122 Leadenhall Street tower in London, with a light blue and blue stained glass facade, stone slab floors, and iron block trim topped by a beacon. It stands about 255 blocks high, 53 wide and 78 deep, built from roughly 160,000 blocks. The interior is not described in the source, and the tower has a stepped, tapering top with a small grass and birch-leaf rooftop garden.

schematics.author: nismopedro
schematics.description: A large palace built mostly from sandstone, stone, and sand with a sandy, desert-style look and a central dome-like tower rising above rounded stone walls. It is very large at about 177 wide, 65 high, and 109 deep, made of roughly 196,000 blocks, with some water features, spruce and oak leaves, and a few netherrack and coal accents. Source description is empty, so the design is inferred from the materials and footprint.

schematics.author: Desdruktiva

title.en: 1st Rate Ship of the Line Sovereign
title.es: Navío de línea Sovereign of the Seas
title.pt: Navio de linha Sovereign of the Seas

schematics.description: A large wooden sailing warship modeled on the 1st rate ship of the line Sovereign of the Seas, built mostly from birch, oak, and dark oak planks with white wool and terracotta sails and trim, plus gold and iron block accents. It is about 43 wide, 134 high, and 149 deep, with a full interior that includes chests, furnaces, hoppers, a beacon, and other working block entities. The source gives no description, so these details come from the block list and dimensions.

schematics.author: Foxy
schematics.description: A long white sci-fi spaceship with blue glass windows, quartz accents, and iron trim, built by Foxy and sized 27 wide, 33 high, and 156 deep. Its body is mostly white wool and stone slabs, with glowing redstone-lamp and piston details, a sign-and-lever control room, and water inside. Its shape is a narrow hull that is tall at the back and about one block high at the front, so it reads as a sleek space cruiser.

schematics.author: Foxy
schematics.description: A large white sci-fi spaceship with a long central spine, a blunt nose and a pair of rounded wings, lit with blue-tinted glass windows, glowstone and redstone lamps. It is built mostly from white wool and stone slabs, with quartz accents and an iron-block frame. Roughly 62 by 144 by 233 blocks, it is a very big vessel; the interior has chests, levers, hoppers and signs, suggesting a working control room.

schematics.author: Foxy
schematics.description: A large white spaceship in the sci-fi style, built mostly from white wool with blue stained glass windows, quartz accents, and iron trim. It is about 64 wide, 36 high, and 72 deep, with a long pointed hull, a wide central section, and a sleek nose. Inside are redstone systems with levers, pistons, lamps, chests, hoppers, and signs, so it works as a functioning-looking vessel rather than just a model.

schematics.author: Foxy
schematics.description: A long, sleek white-and-blue spaceship built mostly from quartz blocks and white wool, with cyan and blue terracotta accents and blue stained glass. It measures about 61 wide, 37 high and 156 deep blocks, and its interior holds a beacon, a music box, a record player, chests and furnaces, with redstone parts throughout.

schematics.author: jduartemiller
schematics.description: A tall, tapering skyscraper replica of 30 St Mary Axe (The Gherkin) in London, with a wide bulging middle narrowing to a rounded point at the top. It is built mostly from spruce planks and glass, with ice, iron blocks, stone at the base, and glowstone lighting. At 55 by 55 blocks across and 183 blocks high, it is a very large single tower, and the source lists ladders and iron doors but no other interior details.

schematics.author: Joebricksy
schematics.description: A large wooden sailing warship in the style of a 6th rate ship of the line, named The Interceptor. It is built mainly from oak, spruce, birch and dark oak planks and slabs, with white wool, smooth quartz and yellow terracotta accents, and it is meant to sit on water. It measures 73 wide, 64 high and 23 deep, and includes a few small details such as flower pots, signs and skulls.

schematics.author: Inon
schematics.description: A large steampunk airship with a wooden oak and spruce hull, black and gray wool detailing, and terracotta accents, built to float in the sky. It is about 101 blocks wide, 103 high and 136 deep, made of roughly 29,000 blocks. The interior has chests, furnaces, cauldrons and signs, and the design centers on a long central hull with rigging, fins and a pointed bow.

schematics.author: Bear_
schematics.description: A large A-frame build with a 66 by 66 block footprint and a height of 28 blocks, sitting on a thick stone and dirt base. Its peaked dark oak and gray terracotta gables are dusted with snow, with black stained glass windows and a light gray carpet interior. Inside are a beacon, furnaces, hoppers, signs, flower pots and skulls, so it reads as a lodge or a base rather than an empty shell.

schematics.author: Luubox
schematics.description: A large symmetrical mansion built on a raised grassy hill, remaking the author's earlier House on a Hill. It uses oak planks, stone, cobblestone, and glass, with a sand-and-stone courtyard layout and tall pitched roofs. At roughly 37 by 19 by 27 blocks, it is a sizeable mansion-style home; the interior has bookshelves, chests, a furnace, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: ilikecutepeople
schematics.description: A large festive winter scene built around pink and blue wool, spruce trees, and glowing lamps, with a whimsical Christmas village feel. It spans about 135 by 149 blocks and stands roughly 116 blocks tall, with a snowy-looking ground of grass and dirt and a few sticky pistons and a sign for detail. The source has no written description, so the subject is inferred from its materials and shape.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A large sculptural build about 62 by 65 by 62 blocks, mostly sandstone with black wool accents, netherrack, and soul sand. Its front view is a rounded, dome-like mass with a dark ring-and-hand pattern, and it has lava, glowstone, and a few oak and birch trees with flowers at the base. Roughly 68,000 blocks in total, with no block entities.

schematics.author: Apimil
schematics.description: A large airship-style assault carrier named Pangolin, part of the Accalis fleet, built mostly from oak planks, white and red wool, and iron blocks. It is long and flat with a stacked hull, a pointed bow, and many small details like glowstone lights, trapdoors, and wall signs. Roughly 194 blocks wide, 56 high, and 85 deep, with about 38,000 blocks; the interior holds chests, furnaces, and a cauldron.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A modern house built mostly from stone slabs, spruce planks, quartz slabs and snow blocks, with large black stained glass windows and a water pond beside it. It is about 43 wide, 20 high and 41 deep, and the source lists a furnace and a flower pot among its block entities. The build sits on grass, podzol and birch leaves with a snowy look.

schematics.author: TheChriZ1995
schematics.description: A very large white and light gray passenger cruise liner with red accents, blue trim, and rows of glass windows along its hull, with oak decks, stairs, and doors. It measures about 173 blocks long, 50 high, and 31 deep, and includes water blocks around the hull. Interior details include a furnace, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: GGJ16

title.es: Yate moderno con cubierta de arenisca
title.pt: Iate moderno com convés de arenito

schematics.description: A modern white-and-sandstone yacht floating on water, with a stepped hull, quartz and sandstone decks, gray-tinted glass windows, and birch plank interiors. It measures about 78 blocks wide, 26 high and 27 deep, and is built from roughly 16,600 blocks, mostly water. Interior rooms include furnaces, hoppers, flower pots and signs for small details.

schematics.author: Fallrise
schematics.description: A wide, low snow-and-ice terrain piece about 46 wide, 14 high and 60 deep, made mostly of dirt, stone, snow blocks and ice, with grass patches, oak and spruce trees, a small water pool, sugar cane, and a few spruce plank and slab accents. It also contains a single furnace, and the source gives no description of its purpose, so it reads as a scenic winter landscape rather than a finished building. Roughly 17,500 blocks in total.

schematics.author: khanaris
schematics.description: A floating fortress built around a cluster of airships, with stone and oak walls, brick accents, and iron blocks along the hull. It stands about 105 blocks wide, 128 high, and 71 deep, and is made of roughly 30,000 blocks. Inside there are chests, furnaces, and trap blocks, with ladders and doors connecting the levels.

schematics.author: playman
schematics.description: A large, dark spawn hub for a factions-style Minecraft server, built mostly from gray, black, and purple wool, stone bricks, and purple stained glass, with cobblestone walls and some water. It measures about 157 by 84 by 157 blocks, with a tiered, spiky main structure and a round-looking layout from above. The source has no description, and the block list shows no block entities, so no interior details are confirmed.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A large fantasy adventure build inspired by Alice: Madness Returns, with a cardboard-cutout bridge and scattered islands of stone, white wool, grass, and oak trees. It spans roughly 213 by 93 by 162 blocks and uses about 70,600 blocks, mostly stone, white wool, and grass. It contains a few chests and signs along its paths and platforms.

schematics.author: Nefashus

title.es: Alicia en el País de las Maravillas

schematics.description: A large fantasy build inspired by Alice: Madness Returns and its Wonderland, built mostly from stone with oak trees, black and gray wool, glowstone accents, and vines spread over a hilly terrain. It measures about 247 by 128 by 167 blocks and uses roughly 193,000 blocks. Inside are a few chests, furnaces, and signs.

schematics.author: Nefashus

title.ru: Кукольный домик из Alice Madness Returns
title.es: Casa de muñecas de Alice Madness Returns
title.pt: Casa de bonecas de Alice Madness Returns

schematics.description: A large fantasy-style dollhouse inspired by Alice: Madness Returns, built mostly from stone with green and lime wool roofs, oak planks, stairs and fences, and glowstone lighting. It measures about 130 blocks wide, 72 high and 97 deep, and uses roughly 70,000 blocks. The interior includes bookshelves, chests and signs.

schematics.author: Nefashus

title.ru: Страна чудес из Alice Madness Returns
title.es: Construcción del País de las Maravillas de Alice
title.pt: Construção do País das Maravilhas de Alice

schematics.description: A large, rugged floating-island style Wonderland scene inspired by Alice: Madness Returns, built mostly from stone, oak leaves, and grass with white and gray wool accents, glowstone lighting, and red mushroom blocks. It spans about 222 by 93 by 144 blocks and has a chest, furnace, and sign inside a few spots. Water, vines, and dandelions add a whimsical, overgrown feel.

schematics.author: DivineMedicus

title.es: Casa del alquimista, obra de concurso
title.pt: Casa do alquimista, trabalho de concurso

schematics.description: A tall, narrow spruce and stone brick house built as a contest entry, styled as an alchemist's home with a cobweb-draped, overgrown look. It is about 36 by 36 blocks across and 97 blocks high, using roughly 11,000 blocks of spruce planks, dirt, stone bricks, and cobwebs, with a small water feature, sugar cane, and oak leaves. Inside are an enchanting table, bookshelves, an anvil, hoppers, signs, and flower pots, with glowstone for light.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large futurist modern house with a sweeping, fish-like silhouette, built mostly from white and cyan quartz, with cyan terracotta accents, blue stained glass panes, and a beacon on top. It measures 64 wide, 27 high and 66 deep, and the build uses about 27,500 blocks. The source gives no description beyond its title, so the interior layout is unknown.

schematics.author: GGJ16
schematics.description: A helicopter build named Antares, made mainly from white quartz blocks, slabs and stairs with cyan wool and black stained glass accents. It is about 31 wide, 9 high and 25 deep, and uses 709 blocks in total. Inside it has chests, a furnace, signs and a trapped chest, and the source gives no further description.

schematics.author: zerkoh
schematics.description: A compact model of the Soviet Antonov AN-2 biplane, built mostly from white quartz slabs, blocks and stairs with green terracotta accents, iron bars, glass pane windows and birch fences. At about 18 by 8 by 21 blocks and roughly 260 blocks total, it is a display piece rather than a flyable craft. It includes a small interior detail with a dropper and a note block.

schematics.author: Jessegator922

title.es: Caza estelar ARC-170 de la República

schematics.description: A blocky replica of the ARC-170 Republic starfighter from Star Wars, built mostly from quartz slabs, quartz blocks and stairs with stone and brick accents, plus a few iron bars and glass panes. It is 37 wide, 9 high and 49 deep, with a long swept-wing body and a pointed nose. The source has no description and no interior, and the block list does not show any hidden rooms.

schematics.author: Romse_One
schematics.description: A 1:1 scale replica of the Arc de Triomphe in Paris, built mostly from stone, stone bricks and cobblestone with iron bars and a few glass panes. It stands about 61 blocks wide, 60 high and 42 deep, with a large central archway flanked by smaller side arches and a flat roof. The source notes no interior features beyond a small furnace and sign.

schematics.author: CraftyFoxe
schematics.description: A large, detailed replica of the US Navy Arleigh Burke Flight IIA guided-missile destroyer, built mostly from polished diorite, cyan and red terracotta, quartz, and black and blue wool, with iron bars, water, and some banners and chests. It is about 21 blocks wide, 40 high, and 155 long, a ship meant to sit on or beside open water. The source gives no description, so the build's details are inferred from its block list and top-down layout.

schematics.author: Mr_Bixx
schematics.description: A large fortified castle in an East Asian style, built mostly from white wool walls with stone brick, cobblestone and nether brick roofs and bases, accented by spruce and oak wood and red and lime terracotta. It sprawls about 178 blocks wide, 133 deep and 62 high, with tiered curved roofs stacked over a central keep and a chest inside. The source gives no description beyond its title and materials.

schematics.author: Apimil
schematics.description: A large sea-going battleship built mostly from oak planks, with iron block armor plating, white and red wool details, and a stepped superstructure. It measures about 47 blocks wide, 59 high and 262 long, making it a very long vessel, and it contains a few interior rooms with chests, a furnace, an enchanting table, a cauldron and bookshelves.

schematics.author: hazggard
schematics.description: A large white-and-birch luxury yacht floating in open water, with a tiered superstructure, red and gray wool accents, black stained glass windows, and quartz trim. It is about 29 wide, 33 high, and 143 long, built from roughly 32,000 blocks, with a sign on the deck and no interior details beyond the hull and cabins shown in the source. Its stern and bow shapes suggest a ship made for sea or ocean settings.

schematics.author: Smon
schematics.description: A large stone castle built mostly from stone, with light gray wool, oak planks, and bricks, set beside a sand-and-water moat-like area with grass and dirt grounds. It is about 103 wide, 68 high, and 117 deep, with roughly 198,000 blocks, and includes bookshelves, chests, furnaces, signs, a record player, and a music box inside.

schematics.author: Commentered
schematics.description: A 1:1 scale replica of the Soviet Kiev-class aircraft carrier Baku, also known as Admiral Gorshkov. It is built mostly from stone, red terracotta and dark prismarine, with black concrete, white wool, iron bars and end rods for details. The build is about 54 wide, 64 high and 275 deep blocks, and the source lists only a skull block entity, with no interior described.

schematics.author: Nati797_
schematics.description: A tall, ornate baroque clock tower built mostly from sandstone and smooth quartz, with gray stained glass windows, spruce plank floors, and gold block accents. It stands about 80 blocks high on a 25 by 25 footprint, with a stepped base, a wide middle section, and a narrower top with a clock face and wool details. It is a decorative landmark with no block entities, so the inside is mostly open floors and ledges rather than working rooms.

schematics.author: RezolutnyDarek
schematics.description: A large baroque palace built mostly from stone bricks, sandstone and white wool, with a grand symmetrical front, tall blocky towers at the corners and a central block with a courtyard visible from above. It is roughly 212 blocks wide, 57 high and 161 deep, a very big structure with around 155,000 blocks, and it includes bookshelves, iron bars, glass panes and gold block accents with a sign inside.

schematics.author: Spee
schematics.description: A large model of the French battleship Jean Bart, built from stone, red and gray wool, and stone slabs, with a hull, superstructure and gun turrets. It is roughly 250 blocks long, 57 high and 35 deep, with about 26,900 blocks in total. Its interior holds no block entities, so it is mainly an exterior display piece.

schematics.author: Laserbilly
schematics.description: A large sci-fi style starship modeled as a light frigate from the Battlestar-inspired TTC build line, with a long hull, a blue glass window band, and a dark cockpit section. It is built mostly from stone bricks, stone slabs, and cobblestone with black wool and dark oak accents, and it is about 124 blocks wide, 23 high, and 51 deep. The interior is not documented, and no block entities are present.

schematics.author: jduartemiller
schematics.description: A large modernist school of architecture in the Bauhaus style, built mostly from white and light gray wool, quartz slabs, glass, and black wool accents, with a stone base and a few oak and acacia trees around it. It measures about 118 blocks wide, 28 high, and 141 deep, and it sits on a grassy, dirt-based plot with a flat roofline and a tall block tower on one side. The interior is mostly unfinished from the data, with a few bookshelves, an oak door, and a couple of flower pots and furnaces as block entities.

schematics.author: BrauhausDerHoffnung
schematics.description: A very large sci-fi style space station built mostly from iron blocks, with a long central spine, a bulbous main hull and smaller arms and pods sticking out from it. Its surfaces mix white, gray and black wool with glass windows, emerald blocks, obsidian and glowstone accents, and some areas show mycelium and ice. It measures about 115 wide, 133 high and 124 deep, and contains interior rooms with chests, enchanting tables, furnaces, a record player and a few lava and water features.

schematics.author: BrauhausDerHoffnung
schematics.description: A large fantasy airship built mostly from white wool, nether brick, spruce planks, iron blocks, and gold blocks, with iron bars, fences, and wall torches adding detail. It measures about 134 wide, 58 high, and 59 deep, with around 17,760 blocks. Chests, signs, and trapdoors are included inside.

schematics.author: BrauhausDerHoffnung
schematics.description: A large roleplay map called The Starflash, built from white wool, iron blocks, stone brick and jungle planks, with many iron bars, glass and gold accents. It spans about 141 by 50 by 218 blocks and contains around 108,000 blocks, with signs, chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a record player and redstone lamps inside. The source page has no description, so its purpose is inferred from the materials and layout alone.

schematics.author: BrauhausDerHoffnung
schematics.description: A large wooden sailing ship built from spruce and dark oak planks, with red wool sails, cobweb rigging, and nether brick fence railings, set in open water. It measures about 29 wide, 61 high, and 74 deep, and is a world download with a built-in interior holding chests, a music box, signs, skulls, and traps. The hull is shaped with a rounded bow and layered decks, reading as a pirate or old-world galleon.

schematics.author: Blockfreunde
schematics.description: A village built into a stony hillside, with stone and stone brick houses, oak and spruce trees, and a grassy dirt base. It measures about 54 wide, 39 high and 64 deep, and includes chests, furnaces, signs, a music block and a skull as block entities. The source gives no description, so this is based only on the block data and layout.

schematics.author: X_hunter33
schematics.description: A large stone-brick replica of the Boeing C-17 Globemaster III military transport aircraft, with a wide fuselage, swept wings, and a tail section, built mostly from stone bricks with black wool and carpet accents. It measures about 65 blocks wide, 26 high, and 69 deep, using around 4,200 blocks. The model includes a few functional parts such as a beacon, chests, a furnace, hoppers, and a control panel, and the source notes it is interactive, though the details of how it works are not described.

schematics.author: MyGodness
schematics.description: A large recreation of the Bosco Verticale, the vertical forest residential towers in Milan, Italy. Two tall, leafy towers rise from a grassy base, their facades covered in oak leaves, birch-plank balconies, and vines, with glass and black and gray wool accents. The build is about 109 blocks wide, 133 high, and 71 deep, with roughly 94,000 blocks total, and contains no interior or block entities.

schematics.author: Ardinia
schematics.description: A tall, rugged tower built mostly from stone, cobblestone, and stone bricks, with a jagged, weathered look and a few accents of nether bricks, red terracotta, and iron bars. It is about 69 wide, 105 high, and 71 deep, and it sits on a plot with a mostly open, stony base. Inside are a beacon and several signs and skulls, and there are small pockets of lava and redstone ore.

schematics.author: CountVeggie
schematics.description: A long wooden bridge carrying a rail track, built mainly from spruce logs for the supports and oak planks, fences, stairs, and trapdoors for the deck and railings. Glowstone adds lighting along the span. It measures 11 blocks wide, 46 blocks high, and 320 blocks deep, with no interior or block entities.

schematics.author: Ostpreusse
schematics.description: A large sandstone and terracotta café built to resemble the Hindenburg airship, with a rounded white-and-blue hull shape, quartz trim, and brick and spruce accents. It is roughly 61 by 52 by 62 blocks and about 35,000 blocks in total, with a furnace and signs as block entities and no detailed interior described in the source.

schematics.author: Aequotis
schematics.description: A long, open tour boat sitting in a water channel, built mostly from quartz slabs and blocks with dark oak trim and gray stained glass windows. It is about 31 wide, 6 high and 11 deep, with a slim bow and stern and a raised cabin-like top section. Inside the hull there are small details such as red beds, a ladder, a wall sign, and a skull and sign block entity.

schematics.author: Yazur
schematics.description: A realistic car-hauler truck built from cobblestone and stone slabs, quartz, and terracotta, with stained glass windows and button details. It is about 5 blocks wide, 10 high, and 38 long, making it a long vehicle that suits road or city scenes. The build is a vehicle model with no interior contents beyond a single sign.

schematics.author: Avalanche_Ali
schematics.description: A large cathedral built mostly from clay, sponge, sandstone, gravel and snow blocks, with a tall central nave, a rounded apse at one end and a tall spire-like tower at the front. It measures about 133 blocks wide, 53 high and 76 deep, and contains a few chests and signs inside.

schematics.author: vinyl-ripp

title.es: Castillo de piedra cubierto de musgo
title.pt: Castelo de pedra coberto de musgo

schematics.description: A large stone castle built mostly from stone bricks with mossy stone, cobblestone, and dirt, softened by oak leaves, vines, and grass for an overgrown look. It measures about 31 wide, 49 high, and 30 deep blocks, with a small water feature, red wool accents, and nether brick fences as detail. No interior blocks or block entities are listed, so it appears to be an exterior-only build.

schematics.author: AAmdahl
schematics.description: A white wool and oak mansion called Chateau de Lufthausen, styled as a flying castle with a tall rounded main body, spruce and oak trim, and glowstone lighting. It measures about 37 wide, 54 high, and 98 deep, built from roughly 10,700 blocks, and includes chests and signs inside.

schematics.author: Citrus
schematics.description: A large minimalist concept build of mostly smooth stone and gray wool, with cold, clean lines and a stark, sculptural silhouette. It sits on a mix of grass, dirt and gravel, with small patches of snow, ice and sugar cane, and includes a furnace and sign inside. At about 40 by 42 by 38 blocks, it is a big, modern structure.

schematics.author: Venom
schematics.description: A large modern house built mostly from stone, stone slabs, and quartz, with white wool and light blue and green terracotta accents. It sits on grass and snow with ice and water patches, and oak and spruce leaves around it. About 58 wide, 24 high, and 67 deep, with roughly 48,700 blocks; it contains a furnace and a sign.

schematics.author: Creator409
schematics.description: A floating fortress built almost entirely from snow blocks and stone slabs, with iron block walls, ice accents, black wool trim, and glass windows, rising into a snowy sky over a water basin. It is very large, about 207 wide by 128 high by 190 deep, with roughly 124,000 blocks, and its interior holds a chest, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree
schematics.description: A large luxury superyacht about 540 feet long, built mostly from light gray and black terracotta with spruce planks, snow, and ice for a polished, frosty look. It sits on water and is roughly 25 blocks wide, 35 high, and 165 deep, with a stepped superstructure over a hull, and contains a few functional elements such as chests, furnaces, hoppers, a beacon, and signs.

schematics.author: I Place Blocks
schematics.description: A large medieval castle built from cobblestone walls, dark oak towers and roofs, and cyan terracotta accents, with snow blocks on parts of the top and a grass base plot. It measures about 102 by 105 blocks across and 99 blocks high, using roughly 30,900 blocks. The schematic includes a single sign, and the source does not describe any interior rooms.

schematics.author: Grimbart
schematics.description: A large colonial-style bank built on a grass and dirt terrace, with a tall central tower topped by a dome-like roof and a long, wide main hall. Its walls are made of quartz pillars, slabs, and stairs with stone brick accents, with light gray glass panes, red carpet, and oak trim. The building is about 61 blocks wide, 22 high, and 88 deep, with a few flower pots, a music block, and signs inside.

schematics.author: Goldeneye33
schematics.description: A large colonial-style mansion built from quartz, stone brick, and bricks, with a green-wool roof, pillared facade, and a surrounding grassy and podzol garden with a pond. Measuring about 82 blocks wide, 32 high, and 125 deep, it is a big estate-scale build. The interior is furnished with chests, furnaces, a beacon, cauldrons, flower pots, and a record player.

schematics.author: Venom
schematics.description: A large colonial-style mansion with quartz and sandstone walls, stone brick and spruce accents, green wool and iron bar details, and oak-leaf-covered grounds set around a water feature. It spans about 94 by 70 blocks and stands roughly 31 blocks high, with a few chests, furnaces, and signs inside.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large modern house built mostly from white quartz blocks and slabs, with gray and green terracotta accents, green wool and carpet, and blue stained glass panes. It sits on a grass and dirt terrace above a water feature, with an oak and spruce tree nearby. The build spans about 121 by 124 blocks and is 23 blocks high, with 72,139 blocks total; the source has no description, and interior contents are not documented beyond a few sign and skull block entities.

schematics.author: --NECK--
schematics.description: A tall, twisted floating-style island built mostly from cobweb, stone, and oak, with a spiraling corkscrew shape rising about 141 blocks high and spanning roughly 94 by 86 blocks. Its look mixes grassy ledges, a stone and brick core, white and red wool accents, and glass windows, and it contains a few chests, a furnace, and signs. The source gave no description, so the form and details come from the block data alone.

schematics.author: Nati797_
schematics.description: A large stone temple ruin rising about 127 blocks high, built mostly from stone and stone bricks with quartz, gold and coal block accents, and partly overgrown with oak and jungle leaves, vines and grass. It sits on a rocky, tiered base with a water pool and a sign, and its footprint is roughly 50 by 50 blocks, with a stepped pyramid-like silhouette in the jungle style. The source gives no description of interior contents, so none are claimed.

schematics.author: jamsessionein
schematics.description: A large floating theater airship built mostly from spruce, jungle, and oak planks with sandstone accents, shaped like a ship's hull with a raised stern and layered decks. At 71 by 81 by 145 blocks it is a very big build, with roughly 66,000 blocks. Its interior holds many functional details such as chests, furnaces, enchanting tables, a beacon, jukebox-style music blocks, and signs.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A solid 17×17×17 cube built mostly from glass and stone, with dirt, sand, grass, black wool, a water layer and several ore blocks. The front and top views are fully filled, so it reads as one closed block rather than an open structure. Inside it holds chests, a mob spawner and signs, and it is a survival map built around a cube shape.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A large medieval fortress recreating Vigil's Keep from Dragon Age: Awakening, built mostly from stone, dirt, grass, oak and spruce, with light blue and gray wool accents. It spans about 96 by 193 blocks and 72 blocks high, using roughly 199,000 blocks, and includes water and sand areas. The build contains a few chests, furnaces and signs.

schematics.author: Dasher
schematics.description: A very large modern skyscraper tower, about 144 by 143 by 145 blocks, with a wide base that narrows into a tall upper section. Its exterior mixes stone, smooth stone, cyan and black wool, and snow and ice blocks, with some oak leaves and jungle slabs at the base. The source has no description, so the interior is unknown.

schematics.author: OfficialChunkyCraft
schematics.description: A long steampunk airship modeled as a missile cruiser, built mostly from light gray and brown wool with oak planks, iron blocks and fence railings. It is about 25 blocks wide, 34 high and 120 deep, with a pointed nose, a stepped central hull and a flared tail. The interior holds chests, furnaces, signs and a few red beds, and glowstone lights the hull.

schematics.author: khakiInferno
schematics.description: A large, mostly symmetrical build, 45 wide, 39 high and 97 deep, made mainly from oak and spruce logs, oak slabs and fences, with white and blue wool, cobweb, iron blocks and nether brick fences. Its interior has chests, a furnace, a record player, signs, trapdoors and red beds, and glowstone provides lighting. The source gives no description, so its purpose is not stated.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree
schematics.description: A large desert-style house built mostly from stone, sand, and sandstone, with gray and lime wool accents, smooth quartz trim, and birch and oak details. It is roughly 50 wide, 24 high, and 59 deep, with a flat-roofed main block and terraced sections rising over sand and gravel ground. Interior details include chests, furnaces, a beacon, a cauldron, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: Hoop281

title.pt: Casa de ilha diagonal de acácia

schematics.description: A very minimal, low house on an island, built with a diagonal stepped shape from acacia stairs and acacia planks. It is 17 blocks wide, 2 high, and 4 deep, and uses 102 blocks in total (68 acacia stairs, 34 acacia planks). It has no block entities or interior details.

schematics.author: jduartemiller
schematics.description: A tall, narrow spruce-plank tower about 170 blocks high, with a bulky base and a slender upper shaft broken up by many glass windows and iron block bands. The build uses roughly 60,000 blocks, mostly spruce planks, glass, and iron blocks, with some stone, glowstone, and a small water feature; it contains no block entities or documented interior. The source has no description, so the purpose is not stated.

schematics.author: Avalanche_Ali
schematics.description: A large replica of the Eiffel Tower built mostly from brown wool and sandstone, with iron-bar and nether brick fence latticework and a wide, open base. It stands about 127 blocks tall and 60 by 60 blocks across, with stairs running up the structure. It is a decorative landmark build with no interior rooms; the source notes few details beyond its name.

schematics.author: Bambuspanda
schematics.description: A large temple built mostly from white quartz blocks, with mossy cobblestone, grass, and leaves softening its outer walls, and water and ice pools set into the terrain. At about 143 by 87 by 145 blocks it is a very big structure, and its interior holds chests, an enchanting table, and ender chests. The source has no description, so the temple look comes from the materials and footprint alone.

schematics.author: Avalanche_Ali
schematics.description: A tall replica of the Empire State Building in pale sandstone and stone brick, with a stepped Art Deco setback profile, a slender spire, and gray wool accents on the upper floors. It is about 52 blocks wide, 255 blocks high, and 86 blocks deep, built from roughly 100,000 blocks. The interior is solid, with no rooms or block entities.

schematics.author: Driscj
schematics.description: A tall, round lighthouse built mostly from stone, cobblestone and sandstone, with a tapering shaft and a pointed top, about 25 by 25 blocks wide and 51 blocks high. Its mechanism is built from sticky pistons, redstone wire, repeaters and glowstone, with a piston-driven light at the top. Inside are a few torches, a bed, a door and a crafting table.

schematics.author: Gigorahk
schematics.description: A huge, free-standing tree built mostly from jungle leaves wrapped around a thick trunk and branches of oak logs, with a small dirt base. It is very large, about 82 blocks wide, 77 high and 72 deep, made of roughly 27,000 blocks, and it has no interior or block entities to explore.

schematics.author: tacoman500v1
schematics.description: A floating-island village built on stone and grass cliffs, with a town of oak houses, wool-roofed buildings, ladders, fences and stair-stepped roofs spread across a wide mountainous base. The build is about 91 wide, 47 high and 94 deep, with roughly 21,900 blocks, and includes a single furnace as its only block entity. Its materials are mostly stone, oak and wool, with orange and white accents.

schematics.author: ImperiumMC
schematics.description: A large collection of stylized trees of mixed species, built mainly from white and red wool with birch, oak, spruce and jungle leaves, plus logs, vines, gravel and a few cobblestone walls and oak fences. It spans about 94 by 98 blocks and 25 blocks high, with the trees scattered across a flat grassy area rather than forming a single structure. The source has no description, so this is inferred from the block list and layout only.

schematics.author: Joebricksy
schematics.description: A floating fantasy airship with a long hull, a rounded blue-and-white envelope, and a bulky wooden deck and rigging. It is built mostly from oak fences, birch slabs, blue terracotta, white wool, snow blocks, and sandstone and quartz accents, with glass windows. About 74 blocks wide, 69 high, and 27 deep, with 6690 blocks total; the interior is not furnished.

schematics.author: GreyHavens
schematics.description: A large fantasy castle built mostly from stone and stone bricks, with black and green wool accents, gold blocks, glowstone lighting and obsidian details. It sits on a grassy base with a walled, multi-tower layout, and is roughly 125 wide, 77 high and 107 deep blocks, with about 84,000 blocks in total. The source has no description, so the interior contents are not documented beyond a single sign.

schematics.author: LaughingUrchin
schematics.description: A large American Federal-style colonial house named after the Adams style, built with quartz columns and stairs, brick and stone brick walls, spruce planks, and green and white wool accents. It sits on a grassy dirt terrain with snow patches and oak trees, and measures about 105 blocks wide, 46 high, and 87 deep. It contains a few chests, a furnace, signs, and a skull.

schematics.author: Mezaka

title.es: Fábrica de Finks de Bioshock Infinite

schematics.description: A large industrial factory themed after Finks Factory from the game Bioshock Infinite, built mostly from stone bricks, quartz pillars, and terracotta accents with iron bars and spruce details. It stands about 79 wide, 82 high, and 111 deep, with a tall stepped front block, rows of windows, and a sprawling base. The interior includes chests, hoppers, droppers, flower pots, a jukebox and record player, and control blocks, suggesting working details.

schematics.author: jdb98
schematics.description: A tall, narrow abstract skyscraper built from spruce planks, stone, dirt, birch logs and stairs, with blue wool and glass accents. It stands about 102 blocks high, 37 wide and 38 deep, and its footprint is a rough cross shape that tapers into a thin spire near the top. The build has a few chests and signs inside, and a small water feature is included.

schematics.author: TrynePlague1.0
schematics.description: A tutorial build of several floating islands made mostly of stone, with grass tops, oak trees, leaves, and small waterfalls and ponds on a few of them. It is a large structure, about 187 by 88 by 156 blocks, with a sky-island look and no interior or block entities. Good as a reference for building floating terrain.

schematics.author: IGLATMB
schematics.description: A large ghostly pirate ship floating on a water sea, built from oak and spruce planks with gray and black wool sails and hanging vines. It spans about 107 wide, 83 high and 36 deep, with a skeleton skull, iron bars, obsidian and chests adding a haunted look, and a small interior with an enchanting table and flower pot. Built in a water-filled setting, it is mostly a decorative ship model.

schematics.author: Mezaka

title.ru: Летающая вилла в стиле Bioshock Infinite
title.de: Fliegende Villa im Bioshock Infinite Stil

schematics.description: A floating villa inspired by Bioshock Infinite, built mostly from stone slabs, stone bricks, spruce planks, bricks and quartz pillars, with lime and orange terracotta accents. It is about 31 wide, 58 high and 40 deep, and the structure includes chests, furnaces, hoppers, droppers, flower pots and signs as interior details.

schematics.author: I Place Blocks

title.en: Stone Fort on a Dirt Mound
title.es: Fuerte de piedra en un montículo de tierra
title.pt: Forte de pedra em um monte de terra

schematics.description: A stone fort built on a tall dirt mound, with a grass top, cobblestone and stone brick walls, spruce plank towers and a few vines and iron bars. It stands about 35 by 35 blocks across and 100 blocks high, and includes a small hollow core with chests, signs, and a skull. The schematic is included with the source.

schematics.author: Das_Felixle
schematics.description: A fort built mostly from dirt, grass, and cobblestone with stone brick trim, styled as an overgrown, weathered stronghold. Vines, jungle and birch leaves, cobwebs, and water add to the abandoned look. It measures about 41 wide, 45 high, and 41 deep, with around 17,000 blocks, and contains chests, signs, skulls, and flower pots.

schematics.author: Linard
schematics.description: A large fantasy sailing ship with a tall stern castle and layered masts, built mostly from spruce planks, oak logs and fences, with red and black wool accents and nether brick trim. It measures about 27 blocks wide, 83 high and 102 deep, using roughly 13,000 blocks, and it has a ladder-accessed interior with beds and chests but no block entities.

schematics.author: Zeranny
schematics.description: A tall, mostly solid fortified wall section built mainly from stone bricks, with quartz block and stair trim, raised towers at both ends, and iron bars, redstone lamps and levers as accents. It stands about 19 blocks wide, 63 high and 23 deep, sitting on a small dirt and grass base, and it has no rooms or interior to enter.

schematics.author: TingyBangy
schematics.description: A large French country chateau with a tall roof, white wool walls, and stone brick and sandstone trim, set among trees and gardens. It spans about 63 by 66 blocks and rises 26 blocks high, built from roughly 23,000 blocks. The interior includes block entities such as furnaces, hoppers, cauldrons, a beacon, and signs.

schematics.author: APPR3NT1C3
schematics.description: A large French countryside mansion built from white wool, stone brick, bricks and oak leaves, with green wool and spruce roofing and grassy, podzol-covered grounds around it. At about 107 by 31 by 88 blocks it is a sprawling estate, with a stone-brick terrace and a few furnished interior details such as chests, furnaces and flower pots. It is a Tropical Biome Sprint (TBS) entry from the WoK project and its source has no description.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree
schematics.description: A helicopter build titled FT Industries, made mainly from quartz stairs and blocks with gray and black terracotta accents and black stained glass windows. It is about 34 wide, 9 high and 29 deep, using roughly 610 blocks, and includes two beacons, chests, a sign, daylight detectors and levers.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree
schematics.description: A sleek private jet built mostly from quartz slabs, quartz blocks and gray terracotta, with a long swept-wing body and a rear tail section. It is about 44 blocks wide, 43 deep and 12 high, roughly 1,300 blocks in total. Inside are a few chests, signs, a daylight detector and a couple of beacons, with light blue and orange wool and carpet accents.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A tall, slender white tower built mostly from quartz blocks, with blue stained glass panes, beacons, and a wide stone base that spans about 60 blocks across. It stands roughly 92 blocks high and 66 deep, with a narrow central shaft, side wings at its lower levels, and a few signs and bookshelves inside.

schematics.author: jar9

title.pt: Casa futurista com torre na neve
title.de: Futuristisches Haus mit Turm im Schnee

schematics.description: A tall, sleek futuristic house built mostly from quartz blocks, quartz slabs and black stained glass, with dark oak accents and a beacon on top. It stands roughly 57 by 63 blocks across and 29 blocks high, with a stepped, multi-tier layout that sits on dirt, snow and podzol. The build has a furnace and a beacon as block entities and no interior details are described in the source.

schematics.author: GoldEsperanto
schematics.description: A large sailing galleon named after Peter the Great, built as a multi-deck wooden warship with white wool and magenta sails and a tall stern. It is about 42 wide, 81 high and 102 deep, made mostly of spruce and oak planks, slabs and fences, with black and red terracotta accents and glass windows. The build has no interior block entities, so chests are only decorative; the source gives no description beyond its title.

schematics.author: GoldEsperanto

title.es: Galeón Venganza de la Reina Ana

schematics.description: A large sailing galleon named after the pirate ship Queen Anne's Revenge, built mostly from spruce, oak, dark oak and jungle wood with black and blue terracotta and black wool accents. It is about 36 blocks wide, 74 high and 85 deep, sitting on a block of water, and it has no block entities, so there are no working chests or furnaces inside. Its hull is tall and layered, with stacked decks and masts visible from the front view.

schematics.author: Yazur
schematics.description: A blocky garbage truck with a red sandstone and cobblestone body, quartz accents, black wool trim, and gray glass windows, built to look like a real refuse lorry. It is 5 blocks wide, 6 high and 17 deep, made from 242 blocks, and has no interior, just a banner, sign and skull as block entities.

schematics.author: Mcholypotato
schematics.description: A massive fantasy gateway with two tall flanking towers and a wide central arch, built from bedrock, obsidian, iron and gold blocks, spruce logs and snow, with lava and soul sand accents and red, black and green wool trim. It is about 57 blocks wide, 86 high and 25 deep, and it is a solid facade with no interior or block entities.

schematics.author: Joebricksy
schematics.description: A giant steampunk locomotive named The Dunnsville Line, built mostly from iron blocks, birch, stone and black wool, with a tall boiler stack, a rounded nose and smaller cars behind it. It measures 108 blocks wide, 45 high and 27 deep, and uses about 20,910 blocks. Inside are chests, furnaces, a music block, signs, skulls and trapped chests as detail.

schematics.author: sp________ace
schematics.description: A large replica of the Eiffel Tower in Paris, built mostly from gold blocks with stone, iron bars and iron blocks for the lattice and base details. It stands about 242 blocks tall and roughly 100 by 100 blocks across at the base, and it is a solid-looking landmark with no interior rooms or block entities. Glowstone and torches provide a few lights, and it works best as a showpiece in an open area.

schematics.author: Richarod
schematics.description: A large gothic-style town hall built mostly from spruce planks, spruce stairs, and stone bricks, with tall pointed spires and a steep central tower rising from a wide stone-brick base. It measures about 51 blocks wide, 51 high, and 48 deep, with roughly 16,600 blocks in total. The interior contains bookshelves, chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a beacon, and other functional block entities.

schematics.author: ImperiumMC
schematics.description: A large medieval-style house built mostly from gray terracotta walls, spruce logs, and spruce slabs, with snow blocks and grass roofing giving it a snowy, mossy look. It measures about 38 wide, 30 high, and 23 deep, using roughly 3,400 blocks. The source has no description, and no block entities or interior details are listed, so the inside is unknown.

schematics.author: CrankerMan

title.en: Grey In Grey Sci-Fi Plot Build

schematics.description: A tall, monochrome sci-fi structure built mostly from dirt, stone, stone bricks, and gray and black stained glass, with glowstone and iron bars for accents. It rises about 99 blocks high on a 51 by 51 footprint, with a stepped, tower-like core and a wide base. The source gives no description of its interior, so none is claimed here.

schematics.author: Aequotis

title.es: Refugio de Trevor en el desierto

schematics.description: A GTA 5 inspired motor home and safehouse built from sand, quartz, and iron bars, with a flat trailer-like body, stepped roof edges, and a long platform running across the top. It sits on a sand and grass base with acacia and jungle leaves, carpets, and sunflowers around it. Roughly 44 by 17 by 27 blocks with about 2,660 blocks; the interior has furnaces, hoppers, a cauldron, flower pots, and signs.

schematics.author: Laserbilly
schematics.description: A large sci-fi style light cruiser built mostly from stone bricks, stone slabs and stairs, with light gray and gray wool detailing and glowstone accents. It is very big at 325 wide, 84 high and 127 deep, made of about 199,000 blocks, and it floats on water with a sloped hull, a long main deck and an open top-down layout. No block entities or interior contents are listed in the source.

schematics.author: McBreakdown
schematics.description: A large sandstone terrace complex with layered tiers, oak trees and leaf canopies, water channels, and grassy planters spilling down the sides, in the style of the legendary Hanging Gardens. Built mostly from about 105,000 sandstone blocks with oak leaves and logs for greenery, plus some red wool, gold blocks, and ice accents. At 116 by 49 by 116 blocks, it is a very large build with no interior and no description from the author.

schematics.author: Ripee123
schematics.description: A fortified PvP spawn area built mostly from gravel, stone bricks, mossy stone and white wool, with quartz stair accents and iron blocks. It is 96 wide, 51 high and 96 deep, with a tall outer wall and corner towers around a lower walled courtyard, and a raised central section holding a chest and sign. The source gives no description beyond its title, so its purpose is taken from the name.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large, dark haunted house built mostly from stone, cobblestone slabs, and bricks, with spruce and oak wood accents, podzol and dirt ground, and heavy vines creeping over the walls. Its footprint is roughly 149 by 141 blocks with a height of 54, making it a sprawling, multi-part mansion with a tall central tower and a grassy yard. Inside are chests, furnaces, flower pots, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: Weerdoh
schematics.description: A tall, spooky haunted house built for Halloween, with a pointed gray-wool and nether-brick roofline, spruce-plank walls, and a mycelium and dirt yard. It is about 32 by 32 blocks across and 94 blocks high, with a tower-like central spire. The interior holds an enchanting table and several signs, and there are glowing redstone torches and iron bars for eerie lighting.

schematics.author: Pgskater1
schematics.description: A large stone castle built on a grassy dirt hill, made mostly of stone bricks with cobblestone walls, stone slabs and stairs, and spruce and oak accents. It has several towers and a wide, tall main body, about 116 wide, 49 high and 138 deep. The interior includes a beacon, chests, hoppers and flower pots, but the source gives no further detail.

schematics.author: jduartemiller
schematics.description: A tall modern skyscraper build based on the Hearst Tower. It is mostly spruce planks, glass, iron blocks and sandstone, with quartz and glowstone accents. It stands about 175 blocks high on a footprint of roughly 47 by 53 blocks, and its interior is mostly solid with no block entities.

schematics.author: Kitty Amazing
schematics.description: A large replica of the German WWII heavy cruiser Prinz Eugen, built as a ship hull with a stepped superstructure. It is mostly red terracotta and stone with stone brick and iron bars detailing, and it is about 23 blocks wide, 53 high and 208 long. The build holds a few small interior details such as hoppers and skulls.

schematics.author: mokazon
schematics.description: A tall, narrow, overgrown stone tower of about 93 by 92 blocks and 192 blocks high, built mostly from stone bricks with cracked and mossy variants, vines, and spruce logs. It has black wool, obsidian, and cyan terracotta accents, iron bars, and a flared, fortress-like base that narrows toward a thin spire. The source has no description and no block entities, so the interior layout is unknown.

schematics.author: Darkone55
schematics.description: A very tall tower-like city building named One Atlantic Centre, about 63 by 63 blocks across and 183 blocks high, far taller than it is wide. Its walls are mostly spruce planks and mossy stone bricks, with many glass panes and blue and gray wool accents, and it has nether brick stair details. It contains bookshelves and glowstone, and its layout appears stacked in floors.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree
schematics.description: A long, sleek high-speed train built from gray and light gray terracotta, quartz blocks and slabs, and black stained glass windows, with iron block accents and a row of beacons along the roof. It is about 172 blocks long, 7 high and 7 deep, with roughly 3,500 blocks in total. Its interior has chests, hoppers, signs and flower pots, and the build is shown as a modern, futuristic train.

schematics.author: jamsessionein
schematics.description: A large airship-style warship built mostly from stone, brown wool, oak planks and iron blocks, with obsidian and lava accents along its hull. It is long and narrow, about 36 blocks wide, 50 high and 164 deep, with a stacked, tiered superstructure that narrows toward the bow and stern. The source has no description, so the look is taken from the block layout and materials alone.

schematics.author: Sherlington
schematics.description: A long, narrow model of the Hogwarts Express steam train, built as a 626-block-long line of red and black wool carriages with jungle plank floors, glass pane windows and iron details. It runs about 13 blocks wide and 33 blocks high, and the source lists a sign as its only block entity. The build is mostly solid blocks, with gravel filling a large share of its volume.

schematics.author: Mark3146
schematics.description: A tall, narrow tower named Hollandia, built mostly from white quartz blocks with oak, spruce and dark oak wood accents, green wool, red carpet and glass windows. It measures about 35 wide, 98 high and 107 deep, with a slim top tapering up from a wider stepped base. The source gives no description of its interior, so none is claimed.

schematics.author: Bambuspanda
schematics.description: A very large clay-built piece by Bambuspanda, about 403 blocks wide, 113 high and 17 deep, made of roughly 62,000 clay blocks. Glowstone accents (about 534) and a few quartz and stone brick blocks break up the surface, and the front view reads as a solid wall-like slab. The source gives no description and no interior, and the top view shows uneven heights along a long, narrow strip.

schematics.author: thebigbaron
schematics.description: A hot air balloon built from white and red wool with gray wool rigging, blue and light blue wool bands, and a wooden basket of birch, dark oak, and spruce with a beacon inside. The round envelope rises about 32 blocks high and is 27 blocks wide, with a small 21-block-deep footprint. It is a decorative flying-machine build with no functional interior beyond the basket.

schematics.author: ToxicBuilds
schematics.description: A large flying airship with a long red-and-white wool hull, stone brick and iron trim, birch and spruce wood decks, and oak fences along the rails. It measures about 133 blocks wide, 69 high and 45 deep, and uses roughly 18,500 blocks. Inside are chests and a few control and music blocks, and it is shown floating above a flat terrain layout.

schematics.author: sogfin
schematics.description: A large stone-built fantasy house on a hilly, snow-dusted site, roughly 71 wide, 54 high and 137 deep, made mostly of stone with oak, spruce and brick accents, dirt and grass terrain, and a small wheat farmland patch. The interior holds chests, furnaces, a record player and signs, with 114,514 blocks in total.

schematics.author: Stratafyre
schematics.description: Icecrown Citadel is a large fantasy fortress built mostly from black obsidian, with snow, snow block, and ice covering its frozen surfaces and gray wool used for accents. A tall central spire rises above a wide, layered base, and the build measures about 101 by 117 by 159 blocks. It contains a single chest, with small touches of lapis block, glowstone, and oak fencing.

schematics.author: Mcholypotato
schematics.description: A large recreation of the Imperial City Arena from The Elder Scrolls, built mostly from stone and cobblestone with mossy accents, oak and spruce details, and iron block trim. It is a wide, low-domed oval with tiered walls and a central sunken floor, around 85 by 86 blocks across and 44 high. Inside you will find a few chests and signs, with sand, water and lava features in the layout.

schematics.author: Murps
schematics.description: A large sci-fi invasion build: a dark, black-wool hull with lime and green accents, iron block plating, glowstone lights and iron bars, rising in a jagged, spread-out cluster. It is 172 wide, 88 high and 109 deep, with about 42,600 blocks, and includes chests, furnaces, a record player and signs inside. The source has no description, so the alien theme comes from the title and the palette.

schematics.author: Banges

title.pt: Ilhota Ipixu à beira do lago

schematics.description: A compact grassy islet built in a lake, with rounded hills of lime and green terracotta, oak, birch, jungle and spruce trees, and lily pads floating on the water. Emerald block, sandstone and dark oak accents add detail. The bounding box is large, but the actual build is small, about 20 blocks across and under 10 blocks high above the water, and it contains a chest and a sign.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree
schematics.description: A large, mostly solid house built from stone and black terracotta, with gray terracotta, snow blocks, and dark oak accents. It is about 68 by 68 blocks across and 31 high, with a stepped, fortress-like massing, a dirt and podzol garden, and a few black stained glass windows. Inside it has furnaces, hoppers, a beacon, flower pots, and signs, and the front shows a tall roofed tower on one side.

schematics.author: Sounas
schematics.description: A towering, dark fortress inspired by Isengard, built mostly from obsidian and bedrock with stone, sandstone, and cobblestone detailing and a few iron blocks. It rises about 126 blocks high, is roughly 36 wide and 34 deep, and is a solid mass with no interior rooms or block entities.

schematics.author: Venom
schematics.description: A modern house built mostly from quartz slabs and blocks, with glass panes, spruce and birch planks, and stone slabs, set in a grassy landscape with oak and jungle leaves, dandelions, poppies, and a small water feature. It spans about 74 wide, 25 high, and 65 deep, with roughly 15,400 blocks. The source has no written description, so the interior layout is not documented.

schematics.author: Tiny_Spider

title.pt: Templo japonês com telhados de pagode

schematics.description: A large Japanese-style temple built from spruce, stone brick, and white wool walls, with tiered pagoda-like roofs, a central hall, and wings on either side. It is about 61 wide, 25 high, and 34 deep, with a small open courtyard edged by water and glowstone lighting. The inside is mostly empty, with no block entities or interior furnishing data listed.

schematics.author: MsIsis
schematics.description: A large fantasy-medieval castle built mostly from stone and stone bricks, with a tall round tower on one side and a wide, low main keep. Accents of oak, purple wool, glass panes and obsidian add color, and the interior holds bookshelves, a ladder, glowstone lighting, an enchanting table and a cauldron. Roughly 50 by 59 blocks across and 59 deep, with about 21,600 blocks in total.

schematics.author: CrankerMan

title.es: Torre oscura de ladrillos del Nether
title.pt: Torre sombria de tijolos do Nether

schematics.description: A tall, narrow tower built mostly from nether brick, stone brick, cobblestone and iron blocks, with a slim spire that flares into a wide, rounded base. It stands about 115 blocks high and 37 blocks across, with a few small window-like openings and a redstone-block core. The interior is empty, with no block entities or functional parts.

schematics.author: Rova
schematics.description: A large, wide build about 138 by 76 by 57 blocks, with a long horizontal beam and a sloping, hull-like body that reads as a ship or vessel from the front. Its main materials are obsidian, oak planks, red wool, glass, spruce logs, glowstone and nether brick fences, with iron blocks and rails. The interior holds utility blocks such as an enchanting table, a record player, a jukebox, chests, furnaces, a cauldron and a dispenser. The source has no description, so the vessel reading is inferred from the shape.

schematics.author: Venom
schematics.description: A large stone castle built on a hill, with a tall central keep, round corner towers, and a sheltered courtyard, made mostly of stone bricks, cobblestone, quartz, and lapis blocks with some ice and oak accents. It measures about 50 blocks wide, 75 high, and 50 deep, and contains a beacon and a furnace inside.

schematics.author: Fingerstache_Jaden

title.es: Tierra de Ooo de Hora de Aventura
title.pt: Terra de Ooo de Hora de Aventura
title.de: Land of Ooo aus Adventure Time

schematics.description: A large, blocky recreation of the Land of Ooo from the cartoon Adventure Time, built mostly from oak logs, dirt, grass and oak leaves, with birch, spruce and terracotta accents and a gold block detail. It is about 94 wide, 76 high and 83 deep, with a mountainous landscape, trees and a few interior-style pieces such as chests, an enchanting table, furnaces and a record player.

schematics.author: Aequotis
schematics.description: A white, boxy Land Rover-style off-road vehicle built mostly from quartz slabs, stone slabs, white carpet, and light gray glass. It is 8 blocks wide, 4 high, and 5 deep, with a flat roof and a short front hood. It has a hopper, a dropper, signs, levers, and pressure plates for interactive details, and the source notes that a tutorial is included.

schematics.author: thebigbaron
schematics.description: A large medieval carrack sailing ship built mostly from spruce slabs, spruce wood, and nether brick fences, with black and light gray terracotta and white wool for the hull and sails. It is about 35 wide, 67 high, and 82 deep, with a tall stacked stern and bow castle, and sits on water. The source has no description and no interior elements listed.

schematics.author: 3D
schematics.description: A modern-style multi-level building made mostly of stone, smooth stone, dirt and gray wool, with jungle plank floors, red wool accents, spruce leaves and a few glass panes. It measures 34 wide, 13 high and 31 deep, and the top-down view shows a stepped layout with a central block and some small tower-like sections. Inside are a furnace, a sign and a skull as block entities, and there is a small water feature with sugar cane, sand and snow.

schematics.author: Milsdar
schematics.description: A medieval-style build made mostly of stone bricks, mossy stone bricks, cobblestone, and oak planks, with oak logs and fences, and blue wool accents. It is roughly 53 by 49 by 115 blocks, about 60,700 blocks in total, and is spread out along its long depth. The interior includes a record player and signs.

schematics.author: Laytak
schematics.description: A very large creation named Loglietha by Laytak, built mostly from cobblestone, grass blocks, glass and terracotta, with sunflowers, tall grass and wheat farmland across its surface. Its footprint is about 177 by 177 blocks and it stands 143 blocks high, shaped like a sprawling terraced landmass with tall towers and a few small furnaces, hoppers and signs inside. The source gives no description beyond the title and material list, so the exact purpose is unknown.

schematics.author: 3RYCK
schematics.description: A large sandstone-and-oak mansion with stone brick trim, a grassy courtyard with dirt paths, and a tall stepped roof section with a central spire-like tower in spruce and oak. The build is about 56 wide, 29 high and 73 deep, with around 16,900 blocks. Inside are bookshelves, an enchanting table, furnaces, a cauldron, a record player, chests and signs, and a small pond with water and flowers in the grounds.

schematics.author: mega_franco
schematics.description: A medieval town square built mostly from stone, stone bricks, oak planks and spruce logs, with white wool and glass pane accents. It measures about 77 by 29 by 83 blocks and is described in its title as part of a larger project. The build includes chests, furnaces and signs inside.

schematics.author: Droolie
schematics.description: A very large airplane build made mostly of light blue terracotta, with smooth stone, quartz, and stone brick trim and red and black wool accents. The top-down view shows a long fuselage with wings spreading out to the sides and a tail section. The footprint is about 453 by 271 blocks and 37 blocks high, and it contains chests, furnaces, hoppers, signs, and other block entities. The source has no description, and its title mentions a pack, so it may include more than one plane.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large symmetrical mansion built mostly from sandstone, quartz, and stone bricks, with spruce wood accents, black glass panes, and water features set among grass lawns. It measures about 169 wide, 38 high, and 142 deep, and the source includes a beacon and signs as block entities, suggesting a furnished interior.

schematics.author: Alvias
schematics.description: A long, sleek sci-fi warship built mostly from white quartz blocks, with cyan terracotta and black wool accents and glowing redstone lamps. It measures about 38 wide, 50 high and 237 deep, so it is a very long, slender ship. Beacons, iron blocks, chests, signs and flower pots are included inside the hull.

schematics.author: Z3N0N
schematics.description: A large mansion built mainly from sandstone, jungle planks, and stone, with glass windows, iron bars, and glowstone lighting, set on a dirt and grass base with some water. It measures 88 wide, 34 high, and 72 deep, about 54,000 blocks. Inside are chests, furnaces, a cauldron, signs, a record player, and music blocks.

schematics.author: flaminsnowman99
schematics.description: A large oak-and-wool manor house with a tall pitched roof, glass windows, and a stone-slab base, set among oak trees with a small water feature and wheat plots nearby. It is roughly 61 wide, 18 high, and 73 deep, with no interior blocks or block entities recorded, so it reads as an exterior-only build. The description is inferred from the block list and layout map, not from the author's notes, which were empty.

schematics.author: Leefield
schematics.description: A giant Mario figure built mostly from blue and red wool with sandstone, snow, and brown wool accents, standing 80 blocks high, 39 wide, and 53 deep. It has a small inner space with a chest, a sign, ladders, and an oak door. The source gives no description beyond its title.

schematics.author: Foxy
schematics.description: A large white sci-fi spaceship with a long hull, a stepped front section and a tall rear fin, built mostly from white wool and stone slabs with glass windows and quartz trim. It measures about 228 blocks wide, 47 high and 180 deep, and has many redstone-powered details inside such as lamps, levers, dispensers, a record player and chests. The source gives no description beyond its title.

schematics.author: zerkoh
schematics.description: A large jet aircraft model built mostly from stone bricks, stone brick slabs and stairs, with cobblestone details, cobweb accents and gray glass panes. It spans about 79 blocks wide, 25 deep and 9 high, using roughly 835 blocks in total. Inside are a few signs, skull blocks and oak and spruce fence gates.

schematics.author: Madnes64
schematics.description: A large medieval cathedral built mostly from stone bricks, stone brick stairs and slabs, with a tall central spire and a long nave rising from a wide flared base. Spruce and dark oak accents, red and gray wool, and blue and black stained glass windows add color and detail to the walls. At about 53 wide, 77 high and 75 deep, it is a massive landmark, with a sign as its only block entity and no interior furnishings listed.

schematics.author: The1Kwa1Jsucsh
schematics.description: A tall medieval clock tower built mostly from cyan terracotta, cobblestone, stone bricks and glass, with spruce and dark oak accents, white wool and glowstone. It stands about 249 blocks high on a roughly 91 by 91 block footprint, with a wide square base that narrows into a bell-style top section. The source gives no interior or clock-mechanism details beyond its title.

schematics.author: Darkcrafter31
schematics.description: A medieval-style inn built from brick, oak planks, and stone slabs, with a grassy dirt base and a large sloped roof. It is about 44 by 23 by 36 blocks and contains a few chests, a furnace, and signs inside. The source gives no description, so the look is taken from the materials and layout.

schematics.author: Darkcrafter31
schematics.description: A medieval-style mansion built from cobblestone, stone bricks, brick stairs, and oak with white and red wool accents, set on a grassy dirt base. It measures about 33 wide, 37 high, and 64 deep, with a roughly 8,000-block footprint and a chest inside. The source gives no description, so the Warhammer theme comes only from the title.

schematics.author: Irvine_
schematics.description: A medieval-style tavern complex built mostly from spruce wood, cobblestone, and oak, with a large barn beside it. The exterior uses spruce leaves and grass on the surrounding ground, and hay bales and white wool add farm detail. Roughly 85 by 113 blocks across and 32 high, it contains chests, furnaces, and signs inside.

schematics.author: Das_Felixle
schematics.description: A medieval jousting and tournament arena built with white wool tents, sandstone and stone brick walls, and spruce and oak wood trim, set on a large dirt and sand field. It is about 87 wide, 38 high and 172 deep, with a few small tent-like structures and a cauldron, chests, an enchanting table, and a furnace inside.

schematics.author: Templario1408
schematics.description: A tall, narrow medieval watchtower built mostly from oak planks, oak logs, and stone bricks, with a stone base and wooden upper floors that step out into a wide overhanging top. It stands about 41 blocks high and 15 by 15 blocks across at its widest, with a ladder climb and a few small storage and sign details inside. The source gives no description, so this is based only on the block list and layout.

schematics.author: TingyBangy
schematics.description: A large Mediterranean-style mansion built mostly from sandstone, smooth sandstone, quartz, stone and brick, with spruce accents, green wool and sand around the grounds. It is about 63 wide, 32 high and 150 deep, roughly 60,000 blocks, with water features and snow blocks in the surroundings. The interior includes furnaces, hoppers, signs, a beacon, a record player and other functional block entities.

schematics.author: TheBello123
schematics.description: A medieval-style house built mostly from dirt, stone, spruce, and oak, with gray terracotta and snow accents and black glass pane windows. It measures about 30 by 30 blocks across and 33 deep, using roughly 7,300 blocks. The source does not describe any interior features.

schematics.author: Nightfire410
schematics.description: A large server spawn area built from sandstone, stone bricks, and chiseled quartz, with glowstone lighting, birch and spruce planks, and oak trim. It is about 104 wide, 67 high, and 103 deep, roughly a round, ringed plaza with a sunken central area and corner towers. Inside are a few chests, an ender chest, furnaces, and signs.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A tall, enclosed box-shaped build, 13 wide, 48 high and 43 deep, with walls mostly of light blue wool, stone, and glass, plus sandstone and black wool. Inside is a small self-contained scene with grass, dirt, oak and spruce trees, vines, a small pool of water, and a chest, a furnace, and a mob spawner. The source gives no description beyond its title and block list, so the exact layout is unconfirmed.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large modern apartment block built mostly from stone, sandstone and quartz, with cyan stained glass windows, light gray wool accents and spruce and birch trees on the grounds. It is roughly 111 wide, 85 high and 115 deep, with a stepped terraced profile and a small pond of water. The source has no description, but the block entities show interior details such as chests, furnaces, hoppers, flower pots and a beacon.

schematics.author: MC_Nightmare
schematics.description: A large modern apartment block with white wool walls, glass pane windows, oak accents, and grass-block roofs and terraces, with dandelions and some greenery for a lived-in look. It is about 88 blocks wide, 82 deep, and 22 blocks tall, a big multi-story city building. The interior includes a few furnaces and signs.

schematics.author: RaptorAnka
schematics.description: A large modern house built mainly from stone, with black and white wool accents, sandstone, glass walls, and birch plank details, with some water around it. It is about 46 blocks wide and deep and 34 blocks tall, and the data shows only a sign inside, so the interior is not documented.

schematics.author: GGJ16
schematics.description: A large modern superyacht built mostly from white quartz blocks and slabs, with black and gray wool, stained glass windows, and iron bar railings. It measures 16 wide, 26 high and 88 deep, with about 13,300 blocks, and sits on a water-filled shallow area beside sandy and stone island terrain. Interior details include droppers, flower pots and signs; the source gives no description, so these details come from the block data alone.

schematics.author: Rolofolo
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from stone, white and black wool, sandstone and glass, with birch and jungle wood accents and a flat, layered roofline. It is roughly 51 by 61 blocks across and 32 blocks tall, with about 46,000 blocks total. Inside are chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a cauldron, a record player and signs, and it sits on a mix of sand, grass and dirt terrain with a water feature.

schematics.author: Pixellicious
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from dirt, stone, white wool, glass panes and oak, jungle and birch planks, with sandstone and stone brick accents. It spans about 102 by 99 blocks and rises roughly 30 blocks high, with a mix of flat and stepped rooflines and a sandy, grassy, partly watery surrounding terrain. Interior features include chests, an enchanting table, a record player, a cauldron, signs, an ender chest and trapped chests.

schematics.author: Pixellicious
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from dirt, stone, snow blocks and birch and spruce planks, with sandstone and light gray wool accents. It is about 97 blocks wide, 25 high and 77 deep, with a sprawling multi-level footprint, glass pane windows, and a snowy-and-sandy terrain base. Interior contains chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a beacon, a record player, cauldron and trapped chest among other block entities.

schematics.author: Pixellicious
schematics.description: A large modern mansion built mostly from dirt, stone, sandstone and white wool, with oak leaves and birch accents, set in a grassy landscape with sand, gravel and a water feature. It measures 72 by 26 by 59 blocks and uses about 28,000 blocks. The interior includes chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a beacon, a cauldron, a record player, music blocks and signs.

schematics.author: Rolofolo
schematics.description: A modern suburban neighborhood built with dirt, snow blocks and gray wool, featuring stone brick houses, glass windows, oak accents and glowstone lighting. It spans about 43 by 27 by 29 blocks and contains a beacon and signs, with a snow-covered ground and a few houses set around a central open area.

schematics.author: Z3N0N

title.es: Villa moderna con acentos de arenisca
title.pt: Villa moderna com detalhes de arenito

schematics.description: A small modern villa built from sandstone, stone slabs, spruce and oak planks, with glass panes, iron bars and glowstone lighting. It is 37 wide, 20 high and 33 deep, roughly 10,000 blocks, with a flat multi-level roof and a grassy, dirt-based lot around it. Inside it has chests, a furnace, a record player and signs, and the build was made for a Keralis server.

schematics.author: pigonge
schematics.description: A large modern resort villa built mostly from stone, stone bricks, and glass, with white wool accents, oak planks, and a water feature. It measures 68 wide, 27 high, and 70 deep, and has grassy grounds and sand around it. The interior includes chests, furnaces, a cauldron, a record player, signs, and trapdoors.

schematics.author: ATalkingRock

title.es: Casa moderna blanca en la playa
