schematics.description: A modern two-storey beach house with a white snow-block exterior, birch plank accents, and stone brick stairs and walls, set on a grassy lot beside a sandy shore and water. It measures about 66 blocks wide, 56 deep, and 25 high, built from roughly 14,000 blocks. Inside there is a furnace, and glowstone provides lighting; the source has no description beyond its title.

schematics.author: TheLastGhost06

title.es: Casino Monte Carlo Noche de Fiesta
title.pt: Cassino Monte Carlo Noite de Festa

schematics.description: A very large casino-style entertainment building with a Monte Carlo theme, built mostly from sandstone, stone bricks, glass, and red, yellow, and black wool on a grass and dirt base. It spans about 152 by 124 blocks and rises roughly 49 blocks high, with a wide, layered facade. The interior includes chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a jukebox, a record player, signs, and a cauldron, suggesting a party or nightlife space.

schematics.author: Mezaka
schematics.description: A large cluster of multi-story fraternity-style houses built from spruce planks, gray wool, smooth stone and quartz, with a mix of stone brick, brick and nether brick accents and a few glass-paned windows. The complex is about 103 blocks wide, 28 high and 44 deep, and contains around 10,400 blocks; the source gives no description of any interior details beyond a skull block entity.

schematics.author: C0smicCow
schematics.description: A large fantasy mushroom house with a red wool and terracotta cap dotted with glass pane windows, set on a stone and quartz trunk with a dirt and podzol base. It stands about 32 wide, 51 high and 33 deep, built from roughly 18,000 blocks, and contains flower pots, a hopper and a music block.

schematics.author: carloooo
schematics.description: A very large statue of a bandit, going by its title, Mustachio Bandito, standing 100 blocks high, 66 wide and 61 deep. It is built mainly from iron blocks and cobblestone, with bedrock, cobblestone walls and stairs, green wool accents, and small touches of lava, obsidian and glowstone. The source gives no description, so its interior and other details are unknown.

schematics.author: NerdsWrath
schematics.description: A large oriental-style architectural build made mostly of stone, with acacia and oak leaves, water, and jungle and birch wood accents, built on a Ravand.org server plot. It measures about 46 blocks wide, 36 high, and 46 deep, with roughly 33,000 blocks in total. The source gives no further description, but the build includes chests, furnaces, signs, flower pots, and a skull, suggesting a lived-in interior.

schematics.author: Mine Maus Craft
schematics.description: A bundle of houses built mostly from dark oak logs and planks, with purple and magenta wool accents, dirt and grass ground, and many flowers such as sunflowers, dandelions, poppies, and azure bluets. The source is large in footprint (132 by 330 blocks) but only about 34 blocks tall, and the houses sit low, with a few interior items like bookshelves, crafting tables, and torches.

schematics.author: Mcholypotato
schematics.description: A massive, fortress-like structure modeled after the Naxxramas raid from World of Warcraft, built mostly from stone bricks and soul sand with sandstone and white wool accents, plus a small water feature. It stands about 66 wide, 72 high, and 58 deep, with a tiered, stepped silhouette and a tall central spire, and it has no interior blocks or block entities beyond the shell.

schematics.author: Nefashus
schematics.description: A large pirate galleon built mostly from oak and spruce planks with black wool sails, sitting on water. It is about 84 blocks wide, 39 high and 17 deep, with 13,698 blocks in total. Inside are bookshelves, chests, signs, glowstone lighting and some iron and gold blocks.

schematics.author: Kieduss

title.es: Acorazado de la Flota del Nether

schematics.description: A large battleship built from obsidian and red wool, styled as a nether-themed warship with a long hull, a raised superstructure and a few stern and bow details. It stands about 129 blocks wide, 53 high and 73 deep, and contains an interior with chests, furnaces, a bookshelf, beds, an enchanting table and a record player. It is made of roughly 37,500 blocks, with most of the mass in obsidian and nether bricks.

schematics.author: 3D

title.pt: Casa de ilha em gradiente neutro

schematics.description: A small modern island home in neutral tones, listed in its source as a luxury island home, built as a narrow strip about 2 blocks wide, 2 high and 30 deep. Its walls and top are mostly dirt, with some sand, stone, grass blocks and one light gray wool block for accent, and the build has no interior or block entities. The footprint suggests a flat, slim platform more than a full house, so check the shape before recommending it as a dwelling.

schematics.author: tacoman500v1
schematics.description: A large, unnamed build from a Planet Minecraft project titled New Somnia 100 Subscribers, with no written description from the author. It measures 162 wide, 43 high and 31 deep, and is built mostly from oak planks, oak logs, sandstone, cut sandstone, cobblestone and dirt, with some glass, orange wool, water and many cobwebs that give it an aged or abandoned feel. The top-down view shows a wide footprint with several tall towers rising at regular intervals, and the front view shows a stepped, tiered mass. It has no block entities, so it contains no working storage or redstone.

schematics.author: RaptorAnka

title.es: Edificios de ladrillo de Nueva York
title.pt: Prédios de tijolo de Nova York

schematics.description: A large cluster of brick city buildings in a New York style, with stone slab rooftops, birch and oak plank accents, glass windows, and a water channel running through the lot. It is about 45 wide, 34 high, and 43 deep, built from roughly 27,900 blocks, with interior details such as chests, furnaces, bookshelves, signs, and a music block. The source has no description, so the look is taken from its materials and layout.

schematics.author: pigonge
schematics.description: A large resort complex built around a big water area, with white wool, glass, and oak planks as the main materials, plus black wool and glowstone accents. It measures about 67 by 78 blocks across and 22 high, and contains chests, furnaces, a record player, and signs as interior details. The source gives no description, so the layout is read from the footprint and front view: several multi-storey blocks with tall roofs and pool-like water spaces.

schematics.author: RuvinRice
schematics.description: A large offshore oil platform built over water, with a stone and iron-block main deck, a tall derrick-style tower, and a rounded support block at its base. It is about 52 wide, 79 high and 73 deep, and contains a few chests, a furnace, a record player and signs. The source has no description, so the look is taken from the block palette and layout.

schematics.author: GGJ16
schematics.description: A tall, blocky office skyscraper built mostly from dirt, stone, sandstone and quartz, with a stepped tower rising from a wide base and a small spire on top. It is about 76 wide, 123 high and 90 deep, with roughly 125,000 blocks, and the interior holds a few furnaces, signs, skulls and trapdoors. The source gives no description beyond its title.

schematics.author: Shizenokami
schematics.description: A multi-tiered Japanese-style pagoda built mostly from spruce logs, oak slabs, stone bricks and grass blocks, with cyan terracotta accents and chiseled quartz detailing. It stands about 70 wide, 77 high and 63 deep, with a stepped roof on a grassy base, a few levers and a hopper, and little interior detail.

schematics.author: GoldEsperanto
schematics.description: A small island build in the Peristera style, rising out of a large sea of water with a wooden hill-top village of spruce, oak and dark oak walls, slabs and stairs, plus white wool and black terracotta accents and a few magenta wool details. It is about 29 blocks wide, 72 high and 80 deep, with 22,322 blocks total. No interior or block entities are included; it is an exterior landscape piece celebrating a 100-subscriber milestone.

schematics.author: Ash
schematics.description: A large sailing ship named Phenyx, built mainly from jungle planks with white wool sails, oak fencing, and spruce logs. Lapis block and glowstone add accent colour and light, and a sign is included. It measures about 83 wide, 80 high, and 27 deep, with roughly 8,500 blocks in total.

schematics.author: Zombunny
schematics.description: A modern police station built from white and cyan terracotta, stone slabs, brick stairs and stone bricks, with black glass windows, iron bars and glowstone lighting. It is a large multi-story civic building about 40 wide, 40 high and 54 deep, with a tall central block, a flat stone-slab base and rooftop details. Inside are chests, hoppers, signs and skulls, suggesting a functional interior with storage and display.

schematics.author: Desdruktiva
schematics.description: A large spruce-and-black-wool galleon with a prismarine accent and a fully furnished interior, built in a world download. It stands about 113 blocks tall and deep and 29 wide, so it is a very large ship, with tall masts and many decks inside. The interior includes chests, furnaces, hoppers, an enchanting table, a beacon, cauldrons and other functional block entities.

schematics.author: IRavenI

title.es: Barco pirata Venganza de la Reina Ana
title.pt: Navio pirata Vingança da Rainha Ana

schematics.description: A pirate ship modeled on the Queen Anne's Revenge from Pirates of the Caribbean, built mainly from oak planks, oak logs, and oak fences, with black and red wool accents and a water-filled hull. It stands about 35 blocks wide, 89 high, and 103 deep, and is built on water, with a few chests and a trapdoor-and-button detail inside.

schematics.author: Rarvizu
schematics.description: A large hilltop mansion built from pink terracotta, stone brick and bricks, with a grass-and-dirt terrain base and a tall tower rising at the back. It is roughly 75 blocks wide, 28 high and 52 deep, made of about 13,000 blocks, with light blue and white wool accents, glass panes, and a few signs and trapdoors inside.

schematics.author: PixelGamePL
schematics.description: A large mosque-style building with a red wool and spruce exterior, accented with yellow terracotta, lapis blocks, and cobblestone walls, rising about 99 blocks high over a roughly 100 by 100 block footprint. Its tall, layered silhouette is built from dirt, spruce stairs and slabs, and oak leaves for greenery, with glowstone lighting and a sign as the only block entity. The source gives no description, so the dome and minaret reading comes from the silhouette alone and the build is a single large structure with no listed interior.

schematics.author: ReinhartServer
schematics.description: A large city build of about 620 by 44 by 48 blocks, made mostly from grass, stone brick, oak planks and oak logs, with cobblestone, white wool and gravel accents and some water. The seen-from-above layout is a flat, mostly open grid of low buildings and scattered short towers rather than one dominant structure. It contains a few chests, furnaces, signs and skulls.

schematics.author: thebigbaron
schematics.description: A large sailing yacht built mainly from oak, spruce, and dark oak planks, with sandstone and gray and white wool for trim and sails, and brown stained glass windows. It sits in open water and measures about 62 blocks wide, 47 high, and 34 deep, with no interior blocks or block entities recorded. The source gives no description beyond its title, so its exact design details are not confirmed.

schematics.author: DasChimp

title.es: Crucero de la República con interior

schematics.description: A large sci-fi style warship with a long red and white hull, gold accents, and a raised bridge tower at the top. It is built from wool, gold blocks, glass and glowstone, and includes a furnished interior with chests, furnaces, signs, ladders, rails and a record player. At roughly 83 by 28 by 116 blocks, it is a very big ship made of about 20,700 blocks.

schematics.author: Rolofolo

title.ru: Средневековый торговый центр в богатом квартале
title.es: Centro comercial medieval del barrio rico
title.pt: Centro comercial medieval do bairro nobre

schematics.description: A large multi-story medieval shopping center built mostly from oak logs, oak planks, nether brick and stone brick, with orange and cyan wool accents and glass windows. It spans about 68 wide, 42 high and 27 deep, and the interior holds chests, furnaces, bookshelves, an enchanting table, an ender chest and signs for stocking shops.

schematics.author: WLhokies
schematics.description: A large Roman-style villa built mostly from light gray wool, brick, and brick slabs, set on a dirt and grass platform with a sandy stone courtyard and a tall stone-walled section. It spans about 86 by 86 blocks and is 16 blocks high, with a spruce and birch tree-lined area and interior details like chests, furnaces, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: Wildfyre
schematics.description: A realistic Roman war galley built mostly from oak and spruce, with a long hull sitting in water, rows of oak and spruce stairs and slabs for the benches and decks, and red and white wool for sails and trim. It is about 99 blocks wide, 36 high and 54 deep, with a small crew area holding chests, a furnace, a crafting table, and signs inside.

schematics.author: Harpspiel
schematics.description: A large cathedral-style church built mostly from stone bricks, sandstone and bricks, with a cross-shaped plan, a tall central spire and smaller towers, plus blue and cyan wool accents and gold blocks. It is about 197 wide, 121 high and 127 deep, with grass and spruce leaves around its base. The build has no block entities, so it is an exterior shell with no working interior features.

schematics.author: Arieben
schematics.description: A very tall, dark sanctum-style structure built mainly from chiseled stone bricks, gray terracotta, and stone brick stairs, with acacia logs, obsidian, glowstone, and carved pumpkins as accents. It measures about 112 wide, 241 high, and 124 deep, with roughly 91,000 blocks, and includes a nether portal block section. The source has no description, so its purpose is inferred only from the title.

schematics.author: Drili
schematics.description: A large medieval build pack of scattered structures on open grass, built mostly from spruce logs and planks, stone, cobblestone and white, gray and black wool, with spruce roofs and stone brick stairs. The footprint is about 246 by 321 blocks and 55 high, so it is a big, spread-out collection rather than one compact house. Some structures contain furnaces, music blocks, signs and traps.

schematics.author: Yazur
schematics.description: A realistic semi-truck model with a blue cab, a long gray-and-white trailer body, and black wool wheel details, built mostly from slabs, carpets and quartz. It spans about 26 blocks wide, 6 high and 6 deep, using 381 blocks in total. It is a solid exterior model with no interior or block entities.

schematics.author: Rova
schematics.description: A large floating airship with a sword-like hull, built mostly from iron blocks, oak planks and white wool, with lapis and gold accents and glowing lights. It is about 153 blocks wide, 71 high and 75 deep, and contains a few rooms with chests, bookshelves, an enchanting table, a furnace, a record player and signs. The source gives no description, so the sword-like shape is inferred from the top-down and side silhouettes.

schematics.author: KurisuPlays
schematics.description: A large luxury super yacht built mostly from water, dark oak, black and gray terracotta, and quartz, with black stained glass windows and a few dark oak and quartz decks stacked along the hull. It is roughly 156 blocks wide, 56 high, and 29 deep, with about 55,000 blocks total, and it has chests, furnaces, signs, and a few hidden trap and skull blocks inside. The materials and the ice and snow blocks suggest it could sit on open ocean or a frozen sea.

schematics.author: Adjuro
schematics.description: A large multiplayer server spawn area, built mostly from grass blocks, stone slabs, glass, and water, with iron blocks, green and gray wool, and oak and birch trees for accents. It is a wide open hub about 185 by 185 blocks across and 57 blocks tall, with a sign as its only block entity and no other interior details listed in the source. It suits a plains or grassland setting.

schematics.author: Leefield
schematics.description: A large farm build, about 54 blocks wide, 16 high and 64 deep, made mostly of grass blocks, sandstone, cobblestone and oak, with some spruce and oak leaves for trees and dandelion and poppy flowers as decoration. Its grassy fields are framed by stepped sandstone and stone block edges, and it contains a few chests, a furnace and signs. The source has no written description, so the layout details here come only from the block data.

schematics.author: ChickenMac7
schematics.description: A large fantasy temple built mostly from stone bricks, stone slabs and stone brick stairs, with glowing lava channels and tall purple and magenta stained glass windows. Its stepped, symmetrical form rises about 67 blocks high on a 57 by 57 footprint, with a pointed spire at the top and a wide base. The build uses about 20,000 blocks and has no block entities, so it is a decorative exterior rather than a functional interior.

schematics.author: Duecre
schematics.description: A very tall, narrow tower about 24 wide, 96 high and 37 deep, built mostly from stone and dirt with quartz pillars, quartz slabs and stairs, and ice and water accents. It also uses diorite, nether brick fences, lapis blocks and glowstone, and includes small farmland plots with wheat near its base. The source has no description, so its purpose and interior layout are not documented.

schematics.author: RedJohnxS
schematics.description: A small, round fantasy arena built for orc combat, with a sand floor, sandstone walls, and tiered spruce seating. Red wool and red terracotta add accents, while lava, skulls, netherrack, and fire give it a menacing look. It measures 83 by 23 by 83 blocks and uses about 44,700 blocks in total.

schematics.author: AsTRoFoNiK
schematics.description: A small fantasy tree house built around a tall oak trunk with leafy canopy and a spruce-plank treehouse on top, set on a grassy island with a water pool. It stands about 37 by 37 blocks across and 69 blocks high, mostly dirt, stone, cobblestone, and leaves, with green wool and terracotta accents. The source has no description, so the nature of the interior is unknown.

schematics.author: AsTRoFoNiK
schematics.description: A compact oriental-themed terrain plot built mostly from stone, cobblestone, stone bricks, and dark oak, with light gray and gray terracotta accents, spruce leaves, mushroom blocks, and a water pool. It measures 37 wide, 60 high, and 37 deep, with a tall stone spire rising on one side above a sloped, rocky landscape. The source gives no description, and the block entities include a flower pot and a record player.

schematics.author: Rolofolo
schematics.description: A tall, narrow-looking office tower in a modern Victorian style, built mostly from snow blocks and sandstone with glass windows and a dark stone base. It stands about 43 wide, 62 high and 40 deep, with a stepped top and a few small rooftop details, and the interior holds chests, a furnace, beacons and signs. It is a large build with roughly 26,000 blocks, best suited to a city or snowy/desert-edge setting.

schematics.author: t3h0nly1
schematics.description: A floating sandstone and sand island with a spruce-and-oak tower rising from its center, scattered with white wool, gold blocks, wall torches, and small platforms. It is large, about 147 by 123 by 114 blocks, built from roughly 49,000 blocks, with water pools and a bookshelf-filled tower top. The source has no description, so the look is inferred from the material list and layout views.

schematics.author: Nefashus

title.es: Castillo de nieve en isla flotante
title.pt: Castelo de neve em ilha flutuante

schematics.description: A large castle built on a floating island, with stone walls and tall towers whose upper sections are covered in snow blocks and snow layers, set over grassy dirt and stone terrain edged with sand and gravel. It measures about 85 by 76 by 94 blocks and uses roughly 123,000 blocks, mostly stone, dirt and snow, with oak trim, brick accents, a few chests, furnaces, bookshelves, a record player and signs inside. No description was provided by the author.

schematics.author: Rova
schematics.description: A large fantasy-style fortress built mostly from spruce logs and oak planks, with a tall jagged tower, orange wool accents, and iron block trim. It stands about 58 blocks wide, 59 high and 80 deep, with a wall of dark spruce on the front side. The interior holds a music room with a record player and noteblocks, an enchanting table, furnaces, chests, a dispenser-based trap section and levers.

schematics.author: Tiresh
schematics.description: A very tall modern tower built mainly from stone with blue wool and light blue stained glass accents, topped with a beacon and iron block details. It measures 49 wide, 174 high, and 45 deep, with about 96,000 blocks in total. The source gives no description, so the design details beyond the materials and block entities are unknown.

schematics.author: Captain_JEK

title.es: Camión de bomberos Spartan con escalera
title.pt: Caminhão de bombeiros Spartan com escada

schematics.description: A fire truck with an aerial ladder, built mostly from quartz stairs, concrete, slabs, carpets and banners, with red and gray tones. It measures 19 blocks wide, 6 high and 6 deep, using about 344 blocks in total. The build includes hoppers, a dispenser, a shulker box, signs and banners as small details.

schematics.author: TobiwanK3nobi
schematics.description: A very large tower built mostly from snow blocks, stone slabs, stone bricks and chiseled stone bricks, with grass-covered terraces and accents of gold blocks, glowstone, iron bars and red and orange wool. It measures 115 wide, 192 high and 115 deep, using about 176,100 blocks, and the source lists no interior or block entities.

schematics.author: PiGi95
schematics.description: A very large gothic-style stone cathedral with a tall front facade, twin-towered look, and a long nave running deep into the build. It is built mainly from stone bricks, brick, and glass, with light blue and red wool accents, sandstone, and a few netherrack and glowstone details. At about 106 wide, 95 high, and 208 deep, it is a huge landmark; the interior contains chests, an enchanting table, and signs.

schematics.author: Yobi_Wan

title.es: Interior del crucero de asalto Gozanti
title.pt: Interior do cruzador de assalto Gozanti

schematics.description: A Star Wars Gozanti-class assault cruiser built as a ship interior, with a sleek hull of cyan terracotta, gray concrete, and smooth stone accents, plus iron and netherite details. It is roughly 123 blocks wide, 66 high, and 204 deep, with about 91,000 blocks in total, and includes block entities such as banners, barrels, lecterns, and signs.

schematics.author: Avalanche_Ali

title.es: Réplica de la Estatua de la Libertad

schematics.description: A large sandstone replica of the Statue of Liberty, standing about 52 blocks wide, 127 high and 52 deep, with a stepped base, robed figure and raised torch arm. Built mostly from sandstone with stone slab trim, diamond block accents, glowstone lighting and birch plank and oak door details. Around 20,800 blocks in total; the interior is not furnished beyond the lighting and a few doors and torches.

schematics.author: Rossky
schematics.description: A large steampunk airship shaped like a battleship, built mostly from oak planks, red and white wool, iron blocks, and black and gray terracotta, with stone brick and glass details and cobweb and sponge accents. It measures about 101 wide, 87 high, and 265 deep, and its slug says it is unfinished. The only block entity is a music block, and no interior is described.

schematics.author: PixelGamePL
schematics.description: A steampunk train engine built mostly from stone bricks, nether bricks, spruce planks and iron blocks, with a tall smokestack, a coal block boiler and anvils for machinery detail. It is large, about 115 by 65 by 219 blocks, and sits on a grass block base with lava and coal accents. It contains a record player and a skull as block entities, and the footprint is a long, narrow shape with the cab and boiler stacked toward the front.

schematics.author: PixelGamePL
schematics.description: A large steampunk city on wheels-style machinery, built mostly from spruce planks, stone bricks, iron and gold blocks, and red wool accents, with clay and redstone lamps adding detail. It is very big, about 139 wide, 71 high and 213 deep, with a dense cluster of towers and rooftops and a long hull-like base. No interior or block entities are included in the data.

schematics.author: Laserbilly
schematics.description: A large naval corvette warship built mostly from stone bricks, with stone brick stairs and slabs forming the hull and cobblestone detailing, plus nether brick accents, gray wool, and glowstone lights. Blue and cyan stained glass add windows along the sides. It is a long, low vessel about 87 blocks wide, 33 high, and 276 long, and the source lists no interior details.

schematics.author: Jessegator922
schematics.description: A flat street intersection modeled on a real crossroads in Gainesville, Florida, with a gray wool road surface, yellow center lines, white crosswalk stripes, stone slab sidewalks, and brick accents. Oak and jungle leaf trees line the area, along with cobblestone walls and wall signs. The build is about 94 by 256 blocks and 20 blocks high, mostly a flat ground layer with roads and sidewalks on top.

schematics.author: MrFruitTree

title.ru: Приморские таунхаусы в стиле де Стейл
title.es: Casas adosadas junto al mar De Stijl
title.pt: Casas geminadas à beira-mar De Stijl

schematics.description: A seaside row of modernist townhouses in the De Stijl style, built mostly from stone and black and red terracotta with spruce accents, set along a sandy, icy shoreline with water. The build is roughly 71 wide, 25 high and 103 deep, about 90,000 blocks. It contains a few chests, hoppers, signs, a beacon and daylight detectors.

schematics.author: Romse_One
schematics.description: A large summer cottage set into natural terrain, mostly built from stone with oak and jungle wood accents, oak leaves, sand, and water nearby. Inside are functional blocks like chests, a furnace, an enchanting table, a cauldron, a record player, and a sign. It measures about 101 by 33 by 95 blocks, with roughly 157,000 blocks in total.

schematics.author: GrayRemnant
schematics.description: A two-unit survival house built from stone bricks, spruce, and dirt with grass roofs and a stone brick frame, sized about 29 by 18 by 15 blocks. The interior holds practical survival setups including a furnace, enchanting table, cauldron, chests, bookshelves, an ender chest, a record player, and flower pots. The source description is empty, so this summary is based on the materials and block-entity list.

schematics.author: thebigbaron
schematics.description: A sailing ship named Tartane, a small Mediterranean-style vessel with a tall hull and layered masts, built mostly from oak, spruce, sandstone, and terracotta with white, gray, and yellow wool sails. It sits in water and measures about 72 by 49 by 30 blocks. The source gives no details about the interior.

schematics.author: Shizenokami
schematics.description: A large Taoist temple built mainly from stone with spruce log pillars, quartz and cyan terracotta accents, and oak slab and stair roofing. It is about 155 wide, 83 high and 106 deep, made of roughly 140,000 blocks, with tiered, stepped rooflines rising to a narrow spire at the top. The data lists no block entities, so the interior is not described and any lighting is only shown as redstone lamps and levers.

schematics.author: GGJ16
schematics.description: A large modern home shaped like a tent, built mostly from stone with a cracked stone brick and quartz accent. It stands about 53 wide, 24 high and 62 deep, with a snowy and icy roof area beside a spruce and jungle slab trim. The build has a furnace, signs, a skull and a trap inside its block entities, and it sits on grass with a small water feature.

schematics.author: Mcholypotato
schematics.description: A large, dark, asymmetric structure built mostly from spruce logs, black and white wool, oak planks, and obsidian, with iron blocks and soul sand, standing in a large body of water. It is about 29 blocks wide, 68 high, and 113 deep, and includes chests, furnaces, signs, a ladder, and glowstone lighting inside. The source gives no description, so its exact purpose is unstated.

schematics.author: --NECK--
schematics.description: A large shoreline build where dirt, stone and oak sit partly in shallow water, with sand, gravel and sandstone around the edges and jungle-wood stairs on the roofs. Its cluster of rooms and peaked roofs rises out of the water and sand, and it measures 110 wide, 43 high and 94 deep, with about 129,000 blocks. Inside are a chest, a furnace and a sign.

schematics.author: ZodiacKiIIer
schematics.description: A large floating airship built from obsidian, stone bricks, black wool and gold blocks, with a dark hull, a long bow and fins at the rear. It is about 152 blocks wide, 137 high and 71 deep, and includes a beacon, chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a record player and signs inside the structure.

schematics.author: Niix24
schematics.description: A large overgrown ruin of a temple, roughly 100 by 100 blocks and 34 high, built mostly from mossy and cracked stone bricks with vines, oak leaves, and grass covering it. It sits on a grass and dirt base surrounded by water with lily pads, and gold and diamond blocks are used as accent materials. The source gives no description of the interior, and it contains no block entities.

schematics.author: Team Origin

title.en: Angel of the East Steampunk Airship

schematics.description: A large steampunk airship built mostly from cobblestone, stone bricks, and spruce wood, with light gray and white wool sails, cobweb rigging, and lapis ore accents. It measures about 125 blocks wide, 53 high, and 40 deep, and the interior holds chests, furnaces, signs, bookshelves, and glowstone lighting along rails and fences.

schematics.author: VISR3
schematics.description: A large flying aircraft carrier inspired by S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Helicarrier from The Avengers, built mostly from stone, black and white wool, glass, and glowstone with a long hull, a raised bridge and multiple decks. It is very large at about 298 by 60 by 141 blocks, with an interior containing chests, furnaces, enchanting tables, and signs.

schematics.author: DustyDesigns
schematics.description: A large Beaux-Arts style library built mostly from terracotta, sand, and stone brick, with sandstone stair details, a tall central mass, and stacked terraces. It stands about 43 wide, 70 high, and 59 deep, and contains bookshelves, a beacon, a cauldron, chests, and signs inside its halls.

schematics.author: Tiresh
schematics.description: A large, streamlined hovering vehicle built mostly from gray wool and gray terracotta, with white terracotta accents and black stained glass windows along its sides. It is about 47 blocks wide, 9 high and 50 deep, with a tapered, sloped hull that gets thicker toward the middle and narrows to a point at the nose. Inside it has a few interactive details such as chests, a jukebox, a record player, beacons, and redstone levers and pressure plates.

schematics.author: Flixter
schematics.description: A large chapel built mostly from stone bricks, with birch, spruce, oak, and acacia planks for contrast and grass-block grounds. Its rounded, dome-like silhouette rises to a central peak, and it measures about 102 wide, 66 high, and 79 deep blocks. The materials list includes an enchanting table, redstone lamps, and a sign, but no other interior details are recorded.

schematics.author: ELEMEENOOPEE
schematics.description: A large modern megayacht built at roughly 1:1 scale, about 165 blocks long, 48 high and 23 deep, with a full interior. Its hull and superstructure use white quartz, light gray and cyan terracotta, black wool and black glass, with jungle wood decks and iron trim. The build sits on water and includes a beacon, control room, flower pots and signs inside.

schematics.author: AsterAlff
schematics.description: A giant Pokéball-shaped house built as a home for a Pokémon, with a red and white sphere shell, a gray center band, and a black-and-gray button detail. It sits on a grassy dirt base with a small water pond around it, and it is about 66 blocks wide, 105 high, and 130 deep. Inside it has a chest, a furnace, and a sign, and it is decorated with glass, lapis, and glowstone accents.

schematics.author: Mark3146
schematics.description: A pirate ship based on the Jackdaw from Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag, built mostly from quartz blocks, oak, spruce, and red wool, with skull decorations and coal-block accents. It measures 41 blocks wide, 100 deep, and 89 high, using about 10,700 blocks in total. Chests, signs, and skulls are placed inside as block entities.

schematics.author: LordGuntaz
schematics.description: A huge futuristic build named The Locust, shaped like a winged insect with a long central body and wide, splayed wing sections. Its look relies on smooth stone and gray and orange wool, with diamond blocks, iron blocks, ice, glass panes and iron bars as accents, plus a few beacons. It measures about 162 by 39 by 155 blocks and holds working-looking interior details such as furnaces, an enchanting table, beds, chests, a record player and signs.

schematics.author: Bambuspanda
schematics.description: A tall, freestanding stone brick tower that rises into a narrow spire, with a wide round base and a flared, tiered middle. It is built mostly from stone bricks, gray and light gray wool, and cobblestone walls, with gold and iron block accents, quartz, glass panes, birch trim, and glowstone lighting in its core. At about 57 wide, 136 high, and 63 deep, it is a very tall landmark that stands alone on a grass and dirt base. The source gives no description, and the interior layout is not documented.

schematics.author: wrxryuu
schematics.description: A steampunk-style arch built over water, made mostly of stone, stone bricks, spruce and oak with wool, glass panes, redstone lamps and blocks, plus fence and trapdoor details. It stands about 81 wide, 59 high and 100 deep, with a large stone-and-wood structure rising from a water base and a rounded arch shape. The build has no interior contents or block entities, so it works as an exterior landmark or bridge-like feature.

schematics.author: Apimil
schematics.description: A large floating sky-carrier airship built mostly from oak planks, white wool, and iron blocks, with a flat hull, stacked decks, and a stern section that rises into a tall fin. It measures about 117 blocks wide, 65 high, and 285 long, making it a very big build with over 120,000 blocks. Interior details include chests, a furnace, an enchanting table, a cauldron, bookshelves, and red beds, plus many signs and torches.

schematics.author: t3h0nly1
schematics.description: A large oriental-style harvester built mostly from oak planks, mossy cobblestone and stone bricks, with a sweeping multi-tier pagoda-like roof and a wheat field of farmland and water channels around its base. It is very big, about 173 blocks wide, 127 high and 173 deep, with over 100,000 blocks. Inside are chests, furnaces and signs for storing and processing the harvest.

schematics.author: Lubdub
schematics.description: A large white-and-wood airship built as a floating vessel with two symmetrical side wings and a long central hull, seen from the front as a twin-hulled shape with a wide, flat deck. It is made mostly of white wool, oak planks, spruce logs and oak fencing, with glass windows, iron block accents and glowstone lighting. At about 63 wide, 67 high and 112 deep, it is a big showpiece build; the interior holds chests, bookshelves, a furnace, a record player and signs.

schematics.author: jduartemiller
schematics.description: A very tall, slender tower-like build, about 243 blocks high, 111 wide and 72 deep, with a stepped, pointed profile on one side. It is built mainly from spruce planks, iron blocks, stone and glass, with dirt and grass at the base. The source has no description; a few ladders, glowstone and a sign are the only interior details listed.

schematics.author: wrxryuu

title.en: Spires of Frosrithe Steampunk Sky City
title.es: Agujas de Frosrithe: ciudad steampunk en el cielo
title.pt: Torres de Frosrithe: cidade steampunk no céu

schematics.description: A steampunk sky build of stacked stone-brick spires, cobblestone walls, and oak log and fence details, with a few water features and redstone lamps for lit accents. It is a large, tall structure about 71 blocks in each direction, built from roughly 9,300 blocks, and it reads as a floating or hovering town rather than a single house. The source gives no description of interior contents, and no block entities are present.

schematics.author: Minecraft Expert
schematics.description: A tall, exact replica of the Stark Tower from the Avengers films, built as a slender modern skyscraper with a grid of light gray and gray wool, spruce planks, and many glass panes for windows. It stands about 150 blocks high, 43 wide and 81 deep, with a wide base that narrows into a lit spire-like top. The build uses a large amount of material (over 61,000 blocks) and includes a few furnaces, signs, and traps inside.

schematics.author: TobiwanK3nobi
schematics.description: A tall, fiery temple built mostly from dark nether bricks and regular bricks, with netherrack, lava pools, fire, and gold blocks accents, and glowing lava and fire effects throughout. It is roughly 103 by 103 blocks across and 192 blocks high, with a tall central spire and smaller wings, and it has no interior blocks or block entities listed. The source has no description, so its purpose is inferred only from the name and materials.

schematics.author: iiwrightii
schematics.description: A large symmetrical temple of nether brick slabs, stone bricks and smooth stone slabs, with a tall domed roof and glowing glowstone accents, rising about 80 blocks high and 85 across. It is built around oak leaves and oak logs with lapis blocks, water channels and iron bars as details, and sits on a grass-topped base. The source has no description, so the look here comes from the block list and the front and top layouts. No interior block entities are listed.

schematics.author: SHADOW01905
schematics.description: A large theater-style build with a rounded, arched front and stepped terraces that rise in tiers from the center. It is made mostly of stone slabs, stone, cobblestone stairs, and grass blocks, with sandstone accents and a very large number of jack o'lantern blocks giving it a glowing Halloween look. The footprint is about 191 by 195 blocks, 79 blocks tall, with roughly 175,000 blocks total; the interior has no block entities listed.

schematics.author: TheDreamSanctuary
schematics.description: A large Renaissance-themed build pack by TheDreamSanctuary, a collection of structures rather than a single building. It is built mainly from oak, dark oak and spruce wood with stone bricks, cobblestone walls, and white and black wool accents, with emerald blocks and ore-block details. It spans about 181 by 27 by 119 blocks, with tall towers and houses, and includes functional block entities such as chests, an enchanting table, furnaces, a mob spawner, a record player and signs.

schematics.author: Zombunny
schematics.description: A large sci-fi starship built almost entirely from cyan terracotta, shaped like a long, narrow interceptor with a flat wedge-shaped body and a bulky raised section near the front. Black wool and black terracotta accents add contrast, with a few quartz slabs and light gray wool details. It is very long and tall-ish, about 84 blocks wide, 41 high, and 256 deep, made of roughly 178,000 blocks, and it has no interior spaces.

schematics.author: skrill94
schematics.description: A small gothic-punk cathedral, about 35 by 35 blocks at the base and 107 blocks tall, with a narrow tower rising above a stepped body. Its walls are built mainly from nether bricks, stone bricks, and gray wool, with soul sand and blue terracotta accents, and it stands on a raised grassy dirt mound with sunflowers and tall grass. The source has no description, and the interior is not shown.

schematics.author: Smink
schematics.description: A full-scale replica of the RMS Titanic ocean liner, built mostly from oak planks, black, white, red and yellow wool, with a dirt and stone hull and a snow-topped deck. It is very large, about 155 blocks wide, 117 high and 420 long, and contains a few interior details such as chests, record players with jukeboxes, signs, and lighting. The source gave no description, so the build's exact interior layout is not documented.

schematics.author: jar9
schematics.description: A large traditional mansion built mostly from bricks, cracked stone bricks, quartz, and spruce wood, with green terracotta and wool accents, set on a grassy and podzol-covered plot with a small water feature. It measures about 177 blocks wide, 34 high, and 141 deep, and includes interior details such as beacons, cauldrons, flower pots, furnaces, signs, and skulls, with a sprawling multi-wing footprint. The source provides no description, so the classic mansion reading comes from its materials and layout.

schematics.author: kirelire
schematics.description: A long stone train station with a tall gray stone body, white and cyan terracotta accents, quartz pillars and slabs, and black stained glass windows. It measures about 60 wide, 41 high, and 151 deep, with a sign as its only block entity and no interior furnishing listed. Its top-down layout shows a long run of raised platform-like sections alongside a central building block.

schematics.author: persons345
schematics.description: A tall, modern-looking apartment tower built mostly from white and light gray wool, with stone slab floors, oak plank accents, and ice and grass-block landscaping at its base. It stands about 120 blocks high on a 44 by 44 footprint, with a glowstone-lit interior and a beacon on top; the source gives no further description of the layout.

schematics.author: 3D
schematics.description: A modern build of stone, smooth stone and jungle wood set on a snowy and gravel terrain, with black wool accents, glass panes and a few oak leaves. It is wide and fairly low, about 38 blocks across, 14 high and 22 deep, with a tall block mass on one side and a lower wall-like slab of stone on the other. Inside it has a furnace, signs and a skull, and a few ores are visible in the walls.

schematics.author: -Ban-
schematics.description: A very tall natural-style giant tree built mostly from oak, spruce, birch and jungle leaves and logs, with stone and dirt forming the trunk base and roots. It stands about 120 blocks high and 52 by 55 across, with a wide leafy crown, a small pond of water and ice, grass and snow patches, cobweb draping, and oak fences and stairs as a few wooden details. Nothing inside; it is a solid exterior sculpture.

schematics.author: Tshara
schematics.description: A large stone castle with a tall central keep, flanking towers with peaked roofs, and a wide base set on a dirt and grass mound. Built mostly from stone, cobblestone and dirt with oak planks, oak logs and fences for trim, plus black and gray wool accents and glass windows. Roughly 54 wide, 64 high and 76 deep, with an interior holding a cauldron, chests, an enchanting table, signs and traps.

schematics.author: Michaelk50

title.es: Estación de Tren de Twilight Town
title.pt: Estação de Trem de Twilight Town

schematics.description: A large recreation of the Twilight Town train station from Kingdom Hearts, built mostly from sandstone, stone bricks, and sand with gold and obsidian accents. The build is roughly 80 wide, 193 high, and 201 deep, with a tall tower-like front and a wide platform area. It contains a few interactive blocks such as an enchanting table, a record player, chests, and signs.

schematics.author: GrayRemnant
schematics.description: A large stone-and-spruce university complex with a tall central tower, a long main hall with rows of arched windows, and a sunken courtyard with a small pond and grass. It is built from stone bricks, spruce planks and logs, with gold and diamond block accents, and it stands about 74 wide, 63 high and 37 deep. Inside are a bookshelf-lined interior area, chests, a beacon, a cauldron, banners, signs and a record player.

schematics.author: Spee

title.en: USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg Warship
title.ru: Корабль USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg
title.es: Buque USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg
title.pt: Navio USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg
title.de: Schiff USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg

schematics.description: A large modern naval ship model of the USNS General Hoyt S. Vandenberg (T-AGM-10), a missile tracking vessel, built mostly from stone and netherrack with light gray and black wool details, glowstone lights, and iron doors. It is about 22 blocks wide, 43 high, and 175 deep, with around 26,800 blocks in total. It has a sign and ladders, and no interior is mentioned in the source.

schematics.author: Se1fD3struct1on
schematics.description: A gray, naval destroyer modeled on the US Navy's DDG-51 Arleigh Burke class, built mostly from stone slabs, light gray and gray wool, red terracotta, and quartz. It is about 25 blocks wide, 64 high, and 157 long, with a stepped superstructure, a flat deck, and a sharp bow. The interior is not described, though the build includes signs, dispensers, comparators, and iron doors and trapdoors.

schematics.author: Helix_area51

title.en: USS John C. Stennis Aircraft Carrier

schematics.description: A large-scale, near 1:1 replica of the Nimitz-class aircraft carrier USS John C. Stennis (CVN-74), built mostly from light gray, gray, and white wool with stone slab and quartz details for the flight deck and superstructure. It measures about 333 blocks long, 75 high, and 85 deep, and uses roughly 98,700 blocks in total. The source has no description and no block entities, so the interior is not documented.

schematics.author: Minjoltgaming08

title.en: Vehicle Pack With Trailers and Equipment
title.ru: Набор транспорта с прицепами и оборудованием
title.es: Paquete de vehículos con remolques y equipo
title.pt: Pacote de veículos com reboques e equipamentos

schematics.description: A large collection of about 147 vehicles, trailers and equipment pieces laid out in rows on a flat area, built mostly from quartz slabs and stairs, stone slabs, white and black wool, and black stained glass for windows. The footprint is roughly 199 by 185 blocks and 20 blocks high, with 18,704 blocks in total. It is a display or showroom style build rather than a working town, with vehicles shown side by side.

schematics.author: Jaganaga

title.es: Palacio de la Isla Eterna Veruciant

schematics.description: A large palace built on an island of stone bricks, cobblestone, and oak trees, with emerald block accents, black wool roofs, glowstone lighting, and glass windows. The build is about 214 blocks wide, 82 high, and 143 deep, with a single chest as its only block entity. The source gives no description, so the layout is read from the material counts and the front and top views.

schematics.author: DustyDesigns
schematics.description: A large fantasy mansion on a 64x64 plot, built mostly from stone bricks, white terracotta, birch and spruce planks, and quartz with light gray glass panes, with spruce and stone brick stairs for rooflines and trim. It stands about 64 blocks tall and wide, with a sprawling multi-wing footprint, a small water feature, and oak leaves for greenery; the source gives no description of interior rooms.

schematics.author: axianerve
schematics.description: A large multi-storey Victorian-style mansion built mainly from red brick, stone brick, spruce and quartz, with white wool accents, glass panes and a grass-block lawn base. It measures about 39 blocks wide, 63 high and 69 deep, roughly 26,700 blocks in total. The interior holds chests, furnaces, hoppers, signs, a record player and music blocks, plus some redstone comparators and trapped chests.

schematics.author: Emily_2010
schematics.description: A two-story Victorian-style house with a steep cyan wool roof, oak plank and stone brick walls, and a tall pointed tower on one side. It measures about 33 blocks wide, 24 high and 30 deep, built from roughly 5,500 blocks, mostly dirt and grass for the grounds. The interior is not described, though the build includes a sign and a few glowstone lights.

schematics.author: Mark3146
schematics.description: A large wooden sailing ship modeled on the Dutch East India Company (VOC) vessel Prins Willem, built mostly from spruce logs, oak planks and white terracotta hull panels. It stands about 94 blocks high and 115 blocks long, with a fence-and-slab rigging look and a few coal and nether brick accents on the deck and stern. The source gives no interior details or block entities, so it reads as an exterior shell only.

schematics.author: GoldEsperanto
schematics.description: A large sailing warship named Red Baron, built with oak and spruce hulls, white wool sails, and gray and black terracotta trim, with a red terracotta accent. It is about 31 blocks wide, 72 high, and 83 long, with the tall masts and rigging rising above a broad hull; it is meant to float on water, and the build includes a large water area. No interior blocks or block entities are recorded.

schematics.author: Medercraft
schematics.description: A large white wool temple built on a pool of water, with stone slab trim, stone accents, and a small grass-and-dirt island at its center. The footprint is about 131 by 130 blocks and it stands roughly 34 blocks high, with glowstone lighting and no interior block entities listed.

schematics.author: inHaze
schematics.description: A large waterfront house built on and over open water, with white and gray wool walls, glass windows, sandstone and sand accents, and oak trim and stairs. It spans about 55 by 55 blocks and rises about 50 blocks high, with mostly water around it. The interior includes chests, furnaces, a record player, and signs.

schematics.author: FunVille
schematics.description: A bundle of several separate western-style buildings in a sand, spruce and terracotta palette, with plank roofs, stair and slab trim, oak fences and glass windows. The full build is 137 wide, 25 high and 103 deep, and includes a cauldron, signs and skull heads as block entities, which suggests interior or prop details.

schematics.author: kostahansen
schematics.description: A large white town hall built mostly from quartz blocks, with stone brick and cobblestone details, a spruce-plank interior element, glass pane windows, and a few gold accent blocks. It has a tall central tower with a pointed spire rising above a broad, multi-tiered main body, and its footprint is roughly 94 by 126 blocks at about 96 blocks high. It uses around 50,000 blocks, and the source contains no block entities, so there is no storage or redstone inside.

schematics.author: --NECK--
schematics.description: A large snowy holiday scene built on a stone and snow hillside, with a frozen water area, ice, and birch and spruce trees. It measures about 89 by 46 by 106 blocks and uses roughly 139,000 blocks, mostly stone, dirt, and snow. Inside are chests, furnaces, a cauldron, a record player, music blocks, and signs, suggesting a playable winter village.

schematics.author: Apimil
schematics.description: A large airship build shaped like a zeppelin, with a long white wool and oak hull, iron block framing, and glass windows along the sides. It is about 117 wide, 58 high and 282 deep, a very long craft with many rooms and details, including chests, furnaces, an enchanting table, a cauldron, and signs. The source is a work in progress and a contest entry, and it was shared with a downloadable angel block app.

schematics.author: AAmdahl
schematics.description: A long, white wool airship modeled as a zeppelin, with a rounded hull and small fins at the tail. Its main material is about 20,000 white wool blocks, with nether brick and stone brick trim, iron bars, and a few glass panes. It is very long for its width, about 257 blocks deep, 47 wide, and 63 high, and it has wall signs, oak doors, and torches inside.

schematics.author: Cephyr
schematics.description: A large floating airship named Zeus, built mostly from oak and spruce planks with stone brick hulls, wool sails, and iron block fittings. It is about 286 by 91 by 139 blocks, made of roughly 130,000 blocks, and includes chests, furnaces, hoppers, a music block, and signs inside its decks and cabins. The source gives no description, so the vessel's exact design is inferred from its materials and layout.

schematics.author: Allay
schematics.description: A small starter hut with oak plank walls, a cobblestone floor, a doorway, a single glass window, and a slab roof. It is a plain 5×5×5 block box with no interior furnishings or block entities. It is a catalog sample for testing the index rather than a finished showcase build.
